title: Impulse Buying and Consumer Well-being in Flash Sales: The Mediating Roles of the Feel-good Factor and Return-exchange
affiliations: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology (SZABIST), Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Karachi Pakistan, Technische Universität of München, Munich, Germany and Institute of Business Administration Karachi Pakistan

detail.title: Impulse Buying and Consumer Well-being in Flash Sales: The Mediating Roles of the Feel-good Factor and Return-exchange
detail.abstract: Impulse purchases during flash sales may deliver instant satisfaction but can lead to financial burdens, guilt, and overall cognitive dissonance for consumers, especially in developing countries where knowledge of proper spending behavior is just beginning to be recognized. Prior research has prominently targeted the negative outcomes of impulse buying (IB), focusing less on its positive effects on consumers and retailers. The purpose of this research is to examine the effects of impulse purchases on consumer well-being (CW) in the South Asian context and analyze the mediating effects of the feel-good factor and return-exchange process as potential means of achieving a win-win strategy for consumers and retailers. Grounded in post-purchase behavior theoryintegrating cognitive dissonance theory, regret theory, and the bottom-up spillover theory of subjective well-being-this study applies partial least squares structural equation modeling to crosssectional survey data collected from 569 online consumers in Pakistan. IB exerts a positive direct effect on CW, with the feel-good factor emerging as the dominant mediating pathway and returnexchange behavior providing a secondary corrective route. The study resolves a longstanding paradox in IB research by demonstrating that flash-sale IB can enhance rather than undermine CW when postpurchase mechanisms are accounted for. It advances post-purchase behavior theory with novel evidence from South Asia and offers actionable guidance for marketers seeking to balance promotional effectiveness with consumer welfare.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于售后行为理论，整合认知失调理论、后悔理论和主观幸福感自下而上溢出理论，通过巴基斯坦569名在线消费者的横截面调查数据，运用偏最小二乘结构方程模型分析发现：闪购中的冲动购买对消费者幸福感具有正向直接影响，"感觉良好因素"是主导的中介路径，退换货行为提供了次要的修正路径。该研究解决了冲动购买研究中的长期悖论，证明了在考虑售后机制时，冲动购买可以增强而非削弱消费者幸福感。
AI.research_question: 在南亚背景下，冲动购买如何影响消费者幸福感？感觉良好因素和退换货过程在其中发挥怎样的中介作用？
AI.motivation: 冲动购买可能带来即时满足但也导致财务负担、内疚和认知失调，尤其是在消费知识刚开始被认识的发展中国家。以往研究主要关注冲动购买的负面结果，较少关注其对消费者和零售商的积极影响，因此需要探究冲动购买对消费者幸福感的正面效应及实现消费者与零售商双赢的策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 售后行为理论，整合认知失调理论、后悔理论和主观幸福感自下而上溢出理论
AI.method: 偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM），基于巴基斯坦569名在线消费者的横截面调查数据
AI.findings: 冲动购买对消费者幸福感具有正向直接影响；感觉良好因素是主导的中介路径；退换货行为提供次要的修正路径；当考虑售后机制时，闪购中的冲动购买可以增强而非削弱消费者幸福感。
AI.theory_contributions: 解决了冲动购买研究中的长期悖论，证明在考虑售后机制时冲动购买可增强消费者幸福感；以来自南亚的新证据推进了售后行为理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销人员提供可操作的指导，帮助其在促销效果与消费者福利之间取得平衡，实现消费者与零售商的共赢。

title: Knowledge Engineering for the Policy-Aware Personalized Opportunity (PAPO) Framework: A Companion Ontology and Flowchart, With Heatwave Response as a Worked Example

detail.title: Knowledge Engineering for the Policy-Aware Personalized Opportunity (PAPO) Framework: A Companion Ontology and Flowchart, With Heatwave Response as a Worked Example

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no dedicated external funding — no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This is a companion paper to the framework's founding description [1] and its operational specification [2]; it assumes the reader already has that context and does not reintroduce the Policy-Aware Personalized Opportunity (PAPO) framework. Its sole focus is a knowledgeengineering development undertaken since those publications: PAPO formalized as a two-layer, OWL-style ontology in YAML-a hazard-agnostic core and a heatwave-specific extensiontogether with a single flowchart rendering the framework's core translation logic as a diagram. Both artifacts are new additions to the framework's open GitHub repository. We report the knowledge-engineering process that produced them, the resulting structure, and why we consider the flowchart-not the formal axioms behind it-the artifact most likely to make PAPO's logic legible to readers who will not work through a full specification. Both artifacts are openly available; this paper is their plain-language companion.

AI.tldr: 本文是PAPO框架的配套论文，报告了将PAPO框架形式化为两层OWL风格本体（YAML格式，包含灾害无关核心层和热浪特定扩展层）以及一个流程图的系统工程过程，并论证流程图比形式化公理更能帮助读者理解框架逻辑。
AI.research_question: 如何将PAPO框架形式化为可公开获取的知识工程制品（本体+流程图），以及哪种制品最能帮助读者理解框架逻辑？
AI.motivation: PAPO框架的原始描述和操作规范较为复杂，读者需要花费大量精力才能理解。作者希望通过知识工程手段（本体形式化和流程图）提升框架的可读性和可获取性。
AI.theoretical_framework: PAPO（Policy-Aware Personalized Opportunity）框架；OWL风格本体建模；知识工程
AI.method: 知识工程方法：将PAPO框架形式化为两层YAML格式的OWL风格本体（灾害无关核心层+热浪特定扩展层），并绘制核心翻译逻辑的流程图；所有制品开源发布在GitHub仓库。
AI.findings: 生成了两个新制品：两层本体和流程图；作者认为流程图（而非形式化公理）是让不打算通读完整规范的读者理解PAPO逻辑最有效的制品。
AI.theory_contributions: 为PAPO框架提供了形式化的本体表示，实现了灾害无关核心与灾害特定扩展的分离设计，丰富了框架的理论表达形式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供开源可获取的本体和流程图制品，以通俗语言降低读者理解PAPO框架的门槛，增强了框架的可复用性和可传播性。

title: A Stochastic Feasibility and Optimization Model for Self-Financing AI Adoption in Rural Pathology Under Medicare Reimbursement Constraints
affiliations: Ohio State University (OSU),  and Ohio State University (OSU) - Wexner Medical Center

detail.title: A Stochastic Feasibility and Optimization Model for Self-Financing AI Adoption in Rural Pathology Under Medicare Reimbursement Constraints

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: All data sources used in this study are publicly available. Federal datasets were obtained directly from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (cms.gov), the Health Resources and Services Administration (hrsa.gov), and the Hospital Cost Report Information System (HCRIS). No patient-level data, protected health information, or insurance claims data were accessed or used at any stage. Institutional Review Board (IRB) approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: The project described was supported in part by R01 CA276301 (PIs: Niazi and Chen) from the National Cancer Institute, Pelotonia under IRP CC13702 (PIs: Niazi, Vilgelm, and Roy), The Ohio State University Department of Pathology and Comprehensive Cancer Center. The content is solely the responsibility of the authors and does not necessarily represent the official views of the National Cancer Institute, the National Institutes of Health, or The Ohio State University.

detail.abstract: Existing literature reports that AI-assisted pathology workflows can increase pathologist throughput by factors ranging from 1.16 to 1.84, corresponding to approximately 16% to 84% greater diagnostic capacity in the workflows studied. Despite reported efficiency gains, adoption of AI-enabled digital pathology remains limited in community and rural settings, where financial, infrastructure, and workforce constraints can impede implementation. We developed a stochastic financial feasibility model that links AI-driven productivity gains in urban pathology departments to performance-linked incremental-revenue sharing, rural pathology capacity, pathologist compensation, and Critical Access Hospital infrastructure costs. The model evaluates whether AI financing, rural compensation sufficiency, and rural infrastructure cost recovery can be achieved simultaneously under uncertainty in parameters derived from federal datasets, published literature, and explicit modeling assumptions. In 50,000 Monte Carlo simulations parameterized using federal datasets, published literature, and explicit modeling assumptions, joint feasibility was achieved in 41.4% of simulations. The model required a minimum efficiency multiplier of 1.165 and produced a five-year combined hospital-and-AI-vendor net present value of $52.45 million under base-case assumptions. Importantly, the proposed mechanism is constructed using existing reimbursement categories and potentially available federal grant mechanisms and does not assume creation of a new AI-specific Medicare payment program.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个随机财务可行性模型，将城市病理科的AI生产力提升与绩效挂钩的增量收入分成、农村病理能力、病理医生薪酬及关键接入医院基础设施成本联系起来。通过50,000次蒙特卡洛模拟，联合可行性在41.4%的模拟中实现，最小效率乘数为1.165，五年净现值为5245万美元。
AI.research_question: AI辅助病理工作流在提高效率的同时，其财务可行性如何在资源受限的社区和农村环境中实现？即AI融资、农村病理医生薪酬充足性和农村基础设施成本回收能否在不确定性条件下同时达成？
AI.motivation: 尽管已有文献报道AI辅助病理可将病理医生吞吐量提高16%-84%，但在社区和农村地区，AI支持的数字化病理采纳仍然有限，主要受制于财务、基础设施和人力约束。需要一种财务机制来弥合这一采纳鸿沟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机财务可行性模型（stochastic financial feasibility model），基于蒙特卡洛模拟方法，结合绩效挂钩增量收入分成机制。
AI.method: 构建随机财务可行性模型，利用联邦数据集、已发表文献和明确建模假设中的参数，进行50,000次蒙特卡洛模拟，评估AI融资、乡村薪酬充足性和乡村基础设施成本回收的联合可行性。
AI.findings: 在50,000次模拟中，联合可行性在41.4%的模拟中实现；模型要求最小效率乘数为1.165；基准情景下五年医院与AI供应商合并净现值为5245万美元。机制利用现有报销类别和潜在联邦拨款机制，无需创建新的AI专用Medicare支付计划。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种将城市AI生产力收益转化为农村病理基础设施投资的财务可行建模框架，填补了AI医疗技术扩散在资源受限环境中财务评估的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种无需创建新医保支付类别的AI病理融资机制，利用现有报销类别和联邦拨款机制，为社区和农村医院采纳AI病理提供可操作的财务路径。

title: Recommendation Quality and the Concentration of Consumption: Experimental Evidence from Netflix
affiliations: , , Cornell University - Cornell Tech NYC, Netflix,  and

detail.title: Recommendation Quality and the Concentration of Consumption: Experimental Evidence from Netflix
detail.abstract: We study an experiment with 8.5 million users on Netflix's recommender system to measure how improvements in recommendation technology affect the set of products that get consumed. Improvements increase total consumption and users' reliance on recommendations while diffusing recommendations and consumption away from the most popular titles ("superstars") toward a larger number of moderately popular titles ("middle-tail"), with minimal effects on the most niche titles ("long-tail"). Our results challenge the notion that recommender systems polarize consumption-raising the consumption shares of the head and tail at the expense of the middle-and suggest that the returns to investing in middle-tail products grow as algorithms improve and platforms scale.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Netflix推荐系统上850万用户的大规模实验，研究推荐技术改进如何影响消费产品的分布。研究发现：推荐改进增加总消费量和用户对推荐的依赖，同时使推荐和消费从最热门产品（"超级明星"）扩散到中等热门产品（"中尾"），而对最冷门产品（"长尾"）影响甚微。这挑战了推荐系统会极化消费（即增加头部和尾部份额、挤压中部）的传统观点。
AI.research_question: 推荐技术的改进如何影响用户所消费产品的分布结构（头部、中部和尾部）？
AI.motivation: 现有观点认为推荐系统可能导致消费极化——头部和尾部产品份额上升、中部产品被挤压。作者希望通过大规模实地实验验证推荐改进对消费分布的因果效应，检验这一被广泛引用的担忧是否成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 长尾理论、超级明星理论、推荐系统与消费分布分析框架
AI.method: 在Netflix推荐系统上开展覆盖850万用户的随机对照实验（A/B测试），比较推荐算法改进前后的用户消费行为差异。
AI.findings: （1）推荐改进增加总消费量；（2）用户对推荐的依赖程度提高；（3）推荐和消费从超级明星向中尾产品扩散，对长尾产品影响甚微；（4）总体效果是消费分布向中部集中，而非头部和尾部两端极化。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）挑战了推荐系统导致消费极化的传统理论假设，提供了相反的经验证据；（2）提出了推荐改进促进"中尾"而非"长尾"增长的新观点；（3）为算法改进与产品市场结构的关系提供了因果证据。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）指导平台在算法改进后的内容投资策略——应加大对"中尾"产品的投入；（2）提醒内容创作者和平台认识到，随着算法改进和平台规模扩大，投资中等热门产品的回报将增长。

title: Ecosystem-Level Manipulation: How Digital Choice Architecture and Dark Patterns Reconfigure Consumer Autonomy in E-Commerce Frameworks
affiliations: Northern Bukidnon State College and Northern Bukidnon State College

detail.title: Ecosystem-Level Manipulation: How Digital Choice Architecture and Dark Patterns Reconfigure Consumer Autonomy in E-Commerce Frameworks
detail.abstract: Modern e-commerce ecosystems increasingly leverage advanced behavioral analytics to deploy dynamic digital choice architectures. While choice architecture can optimize user navigation, its subversion into "dark patterns", manipulative user interface designs present a systemic threat to consumer autonomy. This paper conceptualizes and quantifies Ecosystem-Level Manipulation (ELM) within ecommerce platforms. We develop a socio-technical framework to evaluate how systemic dark patterns reconfigure user decision-making processes. Utilizing an empirical choice experiment (N = 1,200), we model the degradation of consumer autonomy using modified discrete choice equations. Our findings indicate that combined dark patterns create a compounding cognitive tax, reducing autonomous choice velocity by 42% and increasing involuntary cart conversions by 68%. Finally, we contribute a set of "De-Biased Design Principles" as an Information Systems Design Theory (ISDT) countermeasure to safeguard consumer agency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了生态系统级操纵（ELM）的概念框架，通过实证选择实验（N=1,200）量化电商平台中系统性暗黑模式对消费者自主性的侵蚀，发现组合式暗黑模式造成认知税叠加，使自主选择速度降低42%、非自愿购物车转化增加68%，并提出了"去偏设计原则"作为信息系统设计理论（ISDT）的应对方案。
AI.research_question: 电商平台中的系统性暗黑模式（dark patterns）如何影响消费者的决策自主性？如何量化和评估生态系统层面的操纵效应？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注单一暗黑模式的个体层面影响，缺乏对电商平台生态系统层面系统性操纵的全面概念化与量化评估，消费者自主性面临的系统性威胁尚未得到充分认识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会技术框架（Socio-technical framework）、信息系统设计理论（ISDT）、修正离散选择模型（modified discrete choice equations）
AI.method: 实证选择实验（empirical choice experiment），样本量N=1,200，采用修正离散选择方程建模消费者自主性的退化程度。
AI.findings: 组合式暗黑模式产生叠加的认知税效应，使消费者自主选择速度降低42%，非自愿购物车转化率增加68%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次概念化并量化"生态系统级操纵"（ELM）这一构念；将暗黑模式研究从个人层面扩展到生态系统层面；提出了修正离散选择模型作为量化消费者自主性退化的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"去偏设计原则"作为信息系统设计理论（ISDT）的反制措施，为电商平台设计者和监管者提供了保护消费者自主权的可操作设计指南。

title: Childhood Interest in the Rubik's Cube: A Behavioral Indicator of Interest in Math and STEM Education
affiliations: and Utah State University USA

detail.title: Childhood Interest in the Rubik's Cube: A Behavioral Indicator of Interest in Math and STEM Education
detail.abstract: This study examines whether children who demonstrate an early attraction to spatial reasoning puzzles, such as the Rubik's Cube, also report greater enjoyment of math and greater participation in STEM education and careers later in life. Rather than serving as a direct measure of spatial ability, a child's voluntary interest in spatial reasoning puzzles may provide an observable indicator of underlying spatial reasoning ability (Xiao & Zhang, 2021). Using survey responses from 42 adults, we examined the relationships among childhood interest in the Rubik's Cube, enjoyment of math, and subsequent participation in STEM education and careers. This exploratory study found that a child's interest in the Rubik's Cube was positively associated with later enjoyment of math. Exploratory bootstrap mediation analyses indicated that the association between a child's Rubik's Cube interest and participation in STEM education was indirectly associated with math enjoyment. Specifically, participants who reported a greater childhood interest in the Rubik's Cube also reported greater enjoyment of math, which, in turn, was associated with greater odds of majoring or minoring in a STEM discipline in college. The corresponding indirect association for STEM careers was not statistically significant. Although these findings are observational and do not establish causal relationships, they do suggest that a child's voluntary participation in spatial reasoning activities may provide educators and parents with a simple behavioral indicator of later interest in math and education in STEM.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过调查42名成年人，探讨儿童时期对魔方等空间推理谜题的兴趣是否与日后对数学的喜爱及STEM教育和职业参与相关。研究发现，儿童时期对魔方的兴趣与日后数学喜爱程度正相关，并且通过数学喜爱的中介作用，间接与大学STEM专业选择相关，但与STEM职业的间接关联不显著。
AI.research_question: 儿童时期对空间推理谜题（如魔方）的兴趣，是否与其日后对数学的喜爱程度以及STEM教育和职业的参与情况相关？
AI.motivation: 儿童对空间推理谜题的自愿兴趣可能作为其潜在空间推理能力的一种可观察指标，而空间推理能力与数学和STEM领域的发展密切相关。本研究旨在探索这一简单的行为指标是否能够预测儿童日后在数学和STEM领域的兴趣与参与。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以空间推理能力作为理论基础，认为儿童对空间推理谜题的自愿兴趣可反映其潜在的空间推理能力（基于Xiao & Zhang, 2021），从而与数学喜爱及STEM参与相关联。
AI.method: 采用探索性调查研究设计，收集42名成年人的问卷调查数据，运用相关分析和Bootstrap中介分析检验变量间关系。
AI.findings: （1）儿童时期对魔方的兴趣与日后数学喜爱程度正相关；（2）儿童魔方兴趣与大学STEM专业选择的关联通过数学喜爱产生间接效应；（3）儿童魔方兴趣与STEM职业参与的间接关联未达到统计显著性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为空间推理能力如何通过行为指标（如谜题兴趣）外化，并影响个体日后数学态度和STEM教育参与提供了探索性实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育者和家长提供了一个简单、可观察的行为指标——儿童对空间推理活动的自愿参与，可用于识别儿童潜在的数学兴趣和STEM教育发展方向。

title: AI Disclosure and Perceived Authenticity in Cinematic Communication: An Empirical Analysis of Audience Trust, Transparency, and Engagement with AI-Mediated Film Content

detail.title: AI Disclosure and Perceived Authenticity in Cinematic Communication: An Empirical Analysis of Audience Trust, Transparency, and Engagement with AI-Mediated Film Content

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study as it did not involve human participants, animal subjects, or live data collection. The study utilizes a simulated dataset generated solely for methodological illustration and model testing.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is changing film production with script creation, digital effects, picture synthesis, voice and dubbing audio, video synthesis, editing, character and design synthesis, and advertising. Production audiences will likely use AI involvement to interpret film communications differently. This research examines the relationships among AI disclosure, perceived transparency, perceived authenticity, audience trust, audience engagement, and behavioral intention toward AI-mediated film content. As a field dataset was not provided, an empirical example is intended to be a clearly defined simulated crosssectional dataset consisting of 400 audience records distributed across conditions of no disclosure, partial disclosure, clear disclosure, and post-exposure disclosure. Six constructs consisting of four items each were measured on a five-point Likert scale. The analysis included frequencies, descriptive statistics, Cronbach's alpha, Pearson correlations, multiple regression, one-way ANOVA, and bootstrap mediation. The results of this study provide an AI disclosure paradox. AI disclosure increased informational transparency, but decreased perceptions of creativity. For film and content makers, the transparency paradox of AI disclosure means communicating the use of AI has an informational benefit with an assumption of authorship.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了生成式人工智能（AI）在电影制作中的应用背景下，AI披露与感知透明度、感知真实性、受众信任、受众参与度及行为意向之间的关系。通过模拟横截面数据（400条受众记录），研究发现了一个"AI披露悖论"：AI披露虽然提升了信息透明度，但降低了受众对创造力的感知。
AI.research_question: AI披露如何影响受众对AI介导电影内容的感知透明度、感知真实性、受众信任、受众参与度及行为意向？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI正在改变电影制作的全流程（剧本创作、特效、画面合成、配音、视频合成、剪辑、角色设计等），受众可能会以不同的方式解读AI参与的影视传播内容。然而，AI披露（是否告知受众内容由AI生成）与受众反应之间的关系尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 论文涉及透明度理论、真实性感知、信任理论、受众参与理论，核心关注AI披露的信息透明度与创作归因（作者性）之间的张力。
AI.method: 采用模拟横截面数据集，包含400条受众记录，分布在四种条件下（无披露、部分披露、明确披露、事后披露）。六构念各含四个题项，采用五点李克特量表测量。分析方法包括频率分析、描述性统计、Cronbach's alpha信度检验、Pearson相关分析、多元回归、单因素方差分析（ANOVA）及Bootstrap中介分析。
AI.findings: 发现"AI披露悖论"：AI披露增加了信息透明度，但降低了受众对创意的感知。对电影和内容制作者而言，AI披露的透明度悖论意味着，告知AI使用虽然具有信息上的益处，但伴随对作者归属（创作主体性）的假设成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI披露在影视传播语境中的"透明度悖论"，丰富了AI传播与受众感知领域的理论框架，为理解信息透明与创作主体感知之间的权衡提供了实证依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电影和内容制作者提供了关于AI披露策略的实践启示：需要权衡信息披露的透明度收益与创意感知受损之间的代价，从而制定更有效的AI使用沟通策略。

title: Operational Change Is Not Governance Closure: Evidence from a First Field Pilot of AI Change Accountability & Reauthorisation

detail.title: Operational Change Is Not Governance Closure: Evidence from a First Field Pilot of AI Change Accountability & Reauthorisation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author designed, facilitated and evaluated both the method and the pilot, and provides related advisory services; the method is her own work and is used in that practice. The pilot was unpaid in both directions: the organisation paid no fee, no participant received compensation, and no payment was contingent on the findings or on publication. Interpretations, conclusions and the decision to publish are the author's alone.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This is a case study. Participation and non-attributed publication were agreed in writing in advance; the participants approved the verbatim interview notes in full, including the use of excerpts. Participation was voluntary and could be withdrawn; the participants had access to the notes throughout, could decline any content or quotation without consequence, and had no prior relationship with the facilitator. Written confirmation of each published excerpt was additionally obtained through the organisation's review, limited to factual accuracy and confidentiality. No institutional or independent ethics review was conducted for this evaluation; the author practises independently of any institutional research-ethics body, and no exemption determination was sought. The absence of independent ethics review is stated as a limitation in the paper, given the small, role-identifiable participant group and the author's dual adviser-researcher role.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for the method or the pilot evaluation.

detail.abstract:
An AI approval can be careful and still age: models change beneath stable names, exceptions outlive their deadlines, permissions widen, and a visible change becomes a renewed decision only when something returns it to one.

This paper reports the first field pilot of AI Change Accountability & Reauthorisation, a practitioner-derived method that traces one AI change from signal, through decision authority and implementation, to evidence of closure. It distinguishes four evidentiary conditions — operational change, articulated status, formal decision, evidenced closure — none of which is evidence of another. The author applied six of the thirteen tracked components of the method and its evaluation, as facilitator, to one already-executed change in a founder-controlled, mid-sized European technology group: the consolidation of internal AI use onto the group's own platform.

The migration was substantially achieved; closure did not follow. In the participants' verbatim, approved accounts and on the screens they showed, retiring the old access had no owner, no inventory and no completion evidence. A time-limited exception was deferred in writing, then passed its second deadline with no renewed decision — "Formally — it hangs", in the business authority's words. In a separately reconstructed version episode, a change beneath a stable label was reversed when quality degraded, with no review of the affected period identified.

The facilitated trace put these open states, and the closure criteria the participants themselves assembled, into words the organisation's own account did not contain; no organisational record of either was identified. The claim is bounded to the six components applied and to this one organisation (Section 6.8). What the case offers for testing elsewhere is four returns that separate an operational change from a governed one: a date to a decider, a task to an owner, an evidence question at closure, a version change as an event.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了首个"AI变更问责与重新授权"（AI Change Accountability & Reauthorisation）方法的现场试点。研究者作为促进者，在一家创始人控制的中型欧洲科技集团中，追踪了一次已执行的AI变更（将内部AI使用整合到集团自有平台）。研究发现：迁移基本完成，但"闭合"（closure）未能实现——旧权限的退役没有所有者、没有清单、没有完成证据；一项有时限的例外被书面延期后，在第二个截止日期过后仍无重新决策，被业务主管称为"形式上悬而未决"。研究区分了四种证据条件（运营变更、明确状态、正式决策、证据闭合），并提出将运营变更与治理变更分离的四个回报：给决策者一个日期、给所有者一个任务、在闭合时提出证据问题、将版本变更视为事件。
AI.research_question: 如何通过一种实践者衍生方法（AI变更问责与重新授权）来追踪AI变更的全过程（从信号到决策权威、实施再到闭合证据），并识别运营变更与治理变更之间的区分条件？
AI.motivation: AI审批可能看似谨慎但已经过时：模型在稳定名称下发生变化、例外超过截止日期、权限扩大，而可见的变更只有在某件事将其带回决策议程时才成为需要重新决定的事件。现有的AI治理框架未能捕捉这种"变更老化"问题，缺乏对AI变更全生命周期问责和重新授权的实践方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI变更问责与重新授权方法（AI Change Accountability & Reauthorisation），该框架包含13个追踪组件，并区分四种证据条件：运营变更（operational change）、明确状态（articulated status）、正式决策（formal decision）、证据闭合（evidenced closure）——其中任何一个都不能作为另一个的证据。
AI.method: 现场试点（field pilot）方法。研究者作为促进者（facilitator），应用了13个追踪组件中的6个及其评估方法，对一家创始人控制的中型欧洲科技集团中一次已执行的变更（内部AI使用整合到集团自有平台）进行了追踪。方法包括：引导式追踪（facilitated trace）、参与者逐字陈述、屏幕证据展示、以及单独重构的版本事件分析。
AI.findings: 1) 迁移基本达成，但闭合未随之而来；2) 旧访问权限的退役没有所有者、清单和完成证据；3) 有时限的例外经书面延期后，在第二个截止日期过后仍无重新决策——业务主管称"形式上悬而未决"；4) 在单独重构的版本事件中，稳定标签下的变更在质量下降时被逆转，且未对受影响期间进行审查；5) 引导式追踪将开放状态和参与者自行构建的闭合标准纳入了组织自身账目所不含有的表述，且未发现任何组织记录包含这些内容。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将运营变更与治理变更分离的四个"回报"（returns）：给决策者一个日期、给所有者一个任务、在闭合时提出证据问题、将版本变更视为事件。这四个条件为在其他组织中测试AI变更治理提供了分析框架。研究还阐明四种证据条件（运营变更、明确状态、正式决策、证据闭合）之间的非等价性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者提供了可操作的AI变更问责与重新授权方法（13个组件中的6个已获应用验证），帮助组织识别AI变更中未闭合的状态，建立明确的闭合标准和所有权归属，从而避免"审批看起来谨慎但已过时"的治理漏洞。

title: Blockchain-enabled Advances (BEAs): Implications for Consumers and Brands
affiliations: and University of Liverpool - Management School (ULMS)

detail.title: Blockchain-enabled Advances (BEAs): Implications for Consumers and Brands
detail.abstract:
Blockchain-enabled advances (BEAs) are state-of-the-art innovations based on blockchain technology. Recent
years have witnessed the proliferation of the four BEAs: smart contracts, cryptocurrencies, play-to-earn games,
and non-fungible tokens. These BEAs have implications for the marketing field as they affect consumers and
brands. We propose a novel theoretical framework that articulates how the principles that underpin BEAs can
impact consumers and then explains how brands can use BEAs to innovate their products and services. The core
principles of blockchain technology, as well as enhanced digital connectivity, imply that consumers can become
more in control of their data and privacy rights, responsible for their choices, and digitally connected. To cater to
consumers, brands can use BEAs to roll out technology-focused service innovations, customer-focused service
innovations, and product innovations. Based on this perspective, we then advance ten future research questions.
This article aims to advance the nascent field of blockchain in marketing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个新颖的理论框架，阐述区块链赋能进步（BEAs）——包括智能合约、加密货币、边玩边赚游戏和不可替代代币——如何影响消费者行为，以及品牌如何利用BEAs进行产品和服务创新，并在此基础上提出十个未来研究方向。
AI.research_question: 区块链赋能进步（BEAs）如何影响消费者行为？品牌如何利用BEAs创新其产品和服务？
AI.motivation: 近年来智能合约、加密货币、边玩边赚游戏和NFT等区块链技术应用在营销领域快速扩散，对消费者和品牌产生了深远影响，但学术界对区块链在营销中的应用研究仍处于起步阶段，缺乏系统性的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区块链技术的核心原则（数据控制权、隐私权、选择责任、数字连接性）构建消费者影响机制的理论框架，并对应提出品牌创新的三类路径（技术聚焦型服务创新、客户聚焦型服务创新、产品创新）。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性研究，通过综合区块链技术原理和营销文献提出框架性论述，而非实证研究。
AI.findings: 区块链的核心原则和增强的数字连接性使消费者在数据与隐私权方面获得更多控制权、对自己的选择更加负责，并建立更强的数字连接。品牌相应地可以通过技术聚焦型服务创新、客户聚焦型服务创新和产品创新来迎合消费者需求。文章据此提出了十个未来研究问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了区块链在营销领域理论框架的空白，系统性地将区块链技术原理与消费者行为理论及品牌创新理论联系起来，为后续研究提供了理论基础和方向指引。
AI.practical_contributions: 为品牌管理者提供了利用区块链技术进行服务和产品创新的具体路径建议，帮助企业在消费者数据主权和数字连接需求日益增强的背景下制定有效的营销策略。

title: Multi-project Work and Project Performance: Friends or Foes?
affiliations: University of Liverpool - Management School (ULMS),  and Copenhagen Business School

detail.title: Multi-project Work and Project Performance: Friends or Foes?
detail.abstract:
While multi-project work (MPW) is becoming an increasingly popular work arrangement, its relationship with project performance is understudied. On the one hand, MPW is deployed to increase employee worktime utilization and productivity, which should be reflected in more timely project completion. On the other hand, MPW also brings switching costs due to attention residue and cognitive setup. Based on this trade-off, we derive an inverted U-shaped relationship between MPW and project performance. We find support for this relationship in a longitudinal dataset containing 9,649 project-monthemployee observations. More specialized experience, project similarity, and employee familiarity positively moderate the inverted U-shape. Furthermore, the results are robust to a host of model specifications, data structures, assumptions, and alternative explanations. Managerial Summary: How many projects can you work on simultaneously? We study this question in the context of new product development (NPD) projects in a multinational organization. We suggest that multiproject work (MPW) might be a double-edged sword. On the one hand, MPW academics or engineers can be more productive by filling the gaps in their schedules and developing time management practices. On the other hand, MPW also carries switching costs. This trade-off creates an inverted U-shaped relationship between MPW and project performance. So, how can
MPW be more beneficial or less costly? We find that more specialized employees can benefit more from productivity gains while working with familiar members or similar projects can alleviate switching costs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多项目工作（MPW）与项目绩效之间的倒U型关系。一方面，MPW通过填补时间空白提升生产力和利用率；另一方面，它因注意力残留和认知设置带来转换成本。基于这种权衡，作者提出MPW与项目绩效呈倒U型关系，并在包含9,649个项目-月-员工观测值的纵向数据集中得到验证。研究发现，更专业化的经验、项目相似性和员工熟悉度正向调节这一倒U型关系。
AI.research_question: 多项目工作（MPW）与项目绩效之间是什么关系？这种关系受到哪些因素的调节？
AI.motivation: 多项目工作（MPW）作为一种日益流行的工作安排，其与项目绩效之间的关系尚未得到充分研究。既有观点认为MPW能提升员工工时利用率和生产力，但也存在注意力残留和认知设置带来的转换成本，需要系统性地检验这两种力量的净效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 注意力残留理论（attention residue）和认知设置（cognitive setup）理论——解释了多任务切换的认知成本；生产力提升与转换成本的权衡理论框架。
AI.method: 利用包含9,649个项目-月-员工观测值的纵向数据集，采用计量经济学方法检验MPW与项目绩效的倒U型关系，并进行多种模型设定、数据结构和假设的稳健性检验，同时排除替代性解释。
AI.findings: 1. MPW与项目绩效之间存在倒U型关系；2. 更专业化的经验正向调节该倒U型关系；3. 项目相似性正向调节该倒U型关系；4. 员工熟悉度正向调节该倒U型关系；5. 结果在多种模型设定、数据结构和假设下均稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统性地将MPW与项目绩效联系起来，揭示了二者之间的非线性关系；2. 整合了生产力提升与转换成本两种理论视角，提供了权衡框架；3. 识别出调节MPW效果的关键边界条件，深化了对多项目工作认知成本和收益的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织管理层提供MPW配置的实践指导，帮助理解员工应同时参与多少项目；2. 指出具有更高专业化程度的员工更能从MPW中获得生产力收益；3. 建议组织在项目配置时考虑项目相似性和团队成员熟悉度，以降低转换成本。

title: Far Apart, Slower Together: Employee Geographic Distance and Project Delay in Global New Product Development
affiliations: , University of Liverpool - Management School (ULMS) and Copenhagen Business School

detail.title: Far Apart, Slower Together: Employee Geographic Distance and Project Delay in Global New Product Development
detail.abstract: Geographic dispersion is routine in new product development, yet it remains unclear whether employee geographic distance (EGD) slows project execution. We develop a coordination cost perspective in which EGD is postulated to increase project delays because it raises attention allocation and information search costs. We test this framework by using a longitudinal employee-project-month panel from a large manufacturing firm that spans 9,729 observations across Europe, North America, and Asia. We find that greater geographic distance is associated with longer project delays, and that the effect is contingent on employee and project characteristics. The EGD-delay link is attenuated by employee familiarity and project similarity, consistent with lower attention allocation costs, and for specialist employees, consistent with differences in information search costs. We also find that the link is amplified for cross-functional geographic dispersion. Additional analyses document that the association between EGD and project delay is concentrated at later project gates and in high-risk or highly innovative projects. A difference-indifferences test around daylight-saving-time transitions indicates that temporal misalignment alone does not account for the EGD-delay relationship. Taken together, the results inform the literature on new product development, project management, and global work by demonstrating when geographic distance is most consequential for project delay.

AI.tldr: 本文基于一家大型制造企业的纵向员工-项目-月面板数据（涵盖欧洲、北美和亚洲的9,729个观测值），提出协调成本视角，研究员工地理距离（EGD）如何影响新产品开发项目的延迟。研究发现地理距离越大，项目延迟越严重，但该效应受员工熟悉度、项目相似性、员工专业化程度等特征调节，并探讨了跨职能地理分散、项目阶段及风险水平等边界条件。
AI.research_question: 员工地理距离（EGD）是否会延缓新产品开发项目的执行进度？其影响机制和边界条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 地理分散在新产品开发中已成为常态，但现有研究对员工地理距离是否及如何影响项目执行速度缺乏系统性认识，尤其是缺乏基于企业内部微观数据的实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协调成本视角（coordination cost perspective），认为地理距离通过提高注意力分配成本和信息搜索成本来增加项目延迟。
AI.method: 利用大型制造企业的纵向员工-项目-月面板数据（9,729个观测值），覆盖欧洲、北美和亚洲；采用面板回归分析检验EGD与项目延迟的关系及调节效应；使用日光节约时间切换前后的双重差分（difference-in-differences）检验排除时间错配的替代解释。
AI.findings: （1）更大的地理距离与更长的项目延迟显著相关；（2）员工熟悉度和项目相似性会减弱EGD-延迟关系（支持注意力分配成本机制）；（3）专家型员工会减弱该关系（支持信息搜索成本机制）；（4）跨职能地理分散会放大该关系；（5）EGD-延迟关联集中在项目后期关卡和高风险/高创新项目中；（6）日光节约时间切换的双重差分检验表明时间错配本身不能解释EGD-延迟关系。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出并验证了协调成本视角来解释EGD对项目延迟的影响机制，区分了注意力分配成本和信息搜索成本两条路径；（2）识别了员工和项目层面的调节因素，深化了对何时地理距离最影响项目执行的理解；（3）通过实证排除了时间错配的替代解释，强化了理论解释的独特性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理地理分散的新产品开发团队提供指导：可通过增强员工间熟悉度、项目间相似性及优化人员配置来缓解地理距离带来的项目延迟问题；为企业评估跨职能地理分散项目风险、合理规划项目阶段资源投入提供实践参考。

title:
Toward Transparent Model Selection in Marketing Research: 
An Open-science Decision Protocol for Documenting, Justifying, and Reporting Modelling Choices
affiliations: and

detail.title:
Toward Transparent Model Selection in Marketing Research: 
An Open-science Decision Protocol for Documenting, Justifying, and Reporting Modelling Choices

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors are officers of Dromley Intelligence, the firm at which this work was developed. The demonstration uses publicly available European Customer Satisfaction Index data; no client data were used and no third party had any role in the design, analysis or conclusions of the paper. The authors declare no other personal or financial relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a methodological paper. No human participants were involved and no primary data were collected; the worked demonstration uses secondary data from the European Customer Satisfaction Index.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial or not-for-profit sectors. It was conducted internally at Dromley Intelligence.

detail.abstract:
Open science has secured the openness of marketing research’s inputs, data, and code, but not the
accountability of the reasoning behind the model a study reports. This paper names that gap the
transparency paradox of model selection. It locates the layer that pre-registration, code sharing,
multiverse and specification-curve analyses, and recent selection criteria for PLS-SEM each leave
opaque, then develops the Model-Selection Transparency Protocol (MSTP): a methods-agnostic,
five-stage decision-documentation spine with reusable artefacts, demonstrated on genuine
European Customer Satisfaction Index data. Two defensible specifications fit comparably, yet four
selection criteria do not converge decisively on either, and the choice between them implies
opposite managerial conclusions—precisely the situation in which documented reasoning, not a
further statistic, is what the field needs. The MSTP gives researchers, reviewers, and editors a
usable means of documenting, justifying, and reporting modelling choices across statistical and
interpretive traditions, reframing transparency from the sharing of inputs to the accountability of
reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"模型选择透明度悖论"——开放科学保障了研究输入、数据和代码的开放性，但未能保障模型选择背后推理过程的可问责性。作者开发了模型选择透明度协议（MSTP），这是一个方法无关的五阶段决策文档化框架，并通过欧洲顾客满意度指数真实数据进行了演示，旨在将透明度从"共享输入"重新定义为"推理的可问责性"。
AI.research_question: 如何在开放科学框架下解决营销研究中模型选择推理过程缺乏透明度与可问责性的问题？
AI.motivation: 现有开放科学实践（预注册、代码共享、多重宇宙分析和规范曲线分析、PLS-SEM选择标准）各自留有未解决的"不透明层"——即模型选择背后的推理逻辑没有被文档化和问责。作者称此缺口为"模型选择透明度悖论"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放科学、模型选择透明度、研究推理可问责性的概念框架。
AI.method: 提出方法无关的模型选择透明度协议（MSTP），包含五个阶段的决策文档化主线及可复用工件，并在真实的欧洲顾客满意度指数（ECSI）数据上进行实证演示。
AI.findings: 在ECSI数据上，两个看似合理的模型规范均能较好地拟合数据，但四种选择标准无法在两者间产生决定性收敛；且选择不同模型会导致相反的营销管理结论。这恰恰证明了文档化推理过程比进一步计算统计量更为关键。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次明确命名并界定"模型选择透明度悖论"，将透明度概念从"共享输入"重新框架为"推理的可问责性"，为跨统计与解释传统的研究提供统一的透明度理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者、审稿人和编辑提供了一套可操作的MSTP工具，用于文档化、论证和报告建模选择，弥合了开放科学实践中推理问责的空白。

title: Clean Technology Spillovers and Economic Convergence: How Technology Diffusion Can Accelerate Productivity Growth across Developing Economies

detail.title: Clean Technology Spillovers and Economic Convergence: How Technology Diffusion Can Accelerate Productivity Growth across Developing Economies
detail.abstract:
Clean technology diffusion is emerging as one of the strongest accelerators of productivity growth and economic convergence across developing economies. As the report states, “the diffusion of clean technologies acts not as a cost burden, but as a profound catalyst for cross-sectoral productivity growth and economic convergence.”

This research develops a quantitative macro‑systems framework showing how rapid cost‑curve compressions in solar PV, wind, and lithium‑ion batteries—driven by Wright’s Law—reshape the thermodynamic efficiency of national economies. Clean technologies reduce systemic energy costs, enhance network resilience through decentralized mesh-grid geometries, and generate unusually high spillover elasticities (0.15–0.22) that amplify total factor productivity.

The report demonstrates that clean tech adoption produces multi-sector spillovers: industrial digitalization, logistics deflation via electric mobility, agricultural efficiency through solar irrigation and precision tools, and financial inclusion through PAYG solar architectures. These spillovers create non-linear growth multipliers, with decentralized renewable investments yielding an estimated $2.30 in broader economic value per $1 invested.

Empirical case studies from Kenya, Southeast Asia, and Latin America illustrate how clean tech diffusion enables leapfrogging, localized manufacturing capacity, and resilience against polycrisis dynamics. The report concludes that emerging economies adopting decentralized clean technologies are not merely converging with industrialized nations—they are bypassing legacy systems entirely, accelerating poverty reduction and forging high‑productivity macro‑systems through 2050.

AI.tldr: 本文通过定量宏观系统框架，论证清洁技术扩散（太阳能光伏、风能、锂离子电池）不仅是成本负担，更是发展中国家生产力增长和经济趋同的催化剂。基于Wright法则的成本曲线压缩，清洁技术通过降低系统性能源成本、增强网络韧性、产生高溢出弹性（0.15-0.22），带来跨部门溢出效应，每投资1美元可产生约2.30美元的经济价值，使新兴经济体能够绕过传统基础设施实现跨越式发展。
AI.research_question: 清洁技术扩散如何成为发展中国家生产力增长和经济趋同的催化剂？其跨部门溢出效应和增长乘数机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统观点将清洁技术视为成本负担，但清洁技术扩散实际正成为发展中国家生产力增长和经济趋同的最强加速器之一，亟需系统性定量框架阐明其经济影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: Wright法则（成本曲线压缩理论）、宏观系统框架、溢出弹性理论、热力学效率理论
AI.method: 定量宏观系统框架建模，结合肯尼亚、东南亚和拉丁美洲的实证案例研究
AI.findings: 清洁技术采用产生多部门溢出效应（工业数字化、物流通缩、农业效率提升、金融普惠），形成非线性增长乘数；分散式可再生能源投资每1美元产生约2.30美元的更广泛经济价值；新兴经济体可绕过传统系统实现跨越式发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了清洁技术扩散与宏观经济增长之间的定量分析框架，验证了清洁技术溢出效应的高弹性（0.15-0.22）对全要素生产率的放大作用，提出了分散式能源投资的经济乘数估算方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家清洁技术投资决策提供投资回报量化依据（每1美元投入产生2.30美元价值）；为政策制定者提供分散式清洁技术作为绕过传统基础设施、加速减贫和构建高生产力经济体系的实践路径。

title: The Structure of Exploitation on Heterogeneous-Value Loops: Gauge Symmetry, Holonomy, and the Loop Deficit

detail.title: The Structure of Exploitation on Heterogeneous-Value Loops: Gauge Symmetry, Holonomy, and the Loop Deficit
detail.abstract: A charge of exploitation is made in some description of an economy, and the party charged answers in another. Where the two descriptions differ only in bookkeeping, a charge whose truth changes between them can be defeated without any transfer being altered. This paper takes that observation as a principle and follows it. Admissible charges are the ones constant under the symmetry group of re-descriptions, so the group fixes which charges can be made at all. For value of a single kind the group is abelian and leaves one invariant on each closed circuit, the loop deficit, which registers whether circulation returns. For value of several kinds the group is larger, and the invariant becomes the conjugacy class of a matrix holonomy. Two mechanisms of extraction appear there with no counterpart in the single-kind theory. The first is spectral: a circuit whose holonomy has determinant one closes on every aggregate measure while one kind of value compounds without limit and another is extinguished, so aggregate closure criteria are unable to register kind-wise divergence. The second is sequential: two orders of the same exchanges, with identical rates and identical aggregates, leave a contributor in different positions, so an arrangement can redistribute value by sequencing alone. Conditions of exploitation are then restated on the enlarged group, with kind capture and spectral drift added to the absorption, schema power and blocked return of the single-kind case. The contribution is threefold. The first is a criterion of admissibility for exploitation claims, namely invariance under re-description. The second identifies the spectrum, rather than the determinant, as the object that carries kind-wise information around a circuit. The third is the treatment of the order of exchange as an independent locus of extraction, detectable by comparing two sequences of the same exchanges without observation of a whole circuit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出剥削指控的可接受性标准——即在重新描述（re-description）变换下保持不变——并利用对称群分析扩展了剥削理论。在单一价值类型下，群是阿贝尔的，其不变量为环路亏空；在多重价值类型下，群扩大，不变量变为矩阵和乐的共轭类。论文识别出两种单类型理论中不存在的剥削机制：谱机制（determinant为一但各价值类型分别发散或消灭）和序列机制（相同交换不同顺序导致不同分配结果）。据此将剥削条件扩展为包含类型捕获、谱漂移、吸收、模式权力与阻断回报等。
AI.research_question: 在价值重新描述（accounting re-description）下，什么样的剥削指控是合法的（可容许的）？多类型价值体系中是否存在单类型理论无法捕捉的剥削机制？
AI.motivation: 剥削指控在不同会计描述体系下可能真值不同；若两种描述仅存在记账方式差异，那么随描述改变真值的指控可以通过改变记账而规避，而无需改变任何实际转移。因此需要确立一个原则，使得剥削指控在重新描述变换下保持不变，从而具有稳健性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 对称群理论、重新描述对称群的表示论、矩阵和乐（holonomy）与环路亏空（loop deficit）概念。
AI.method: 理论推演与数学建模。以重新描述对称群为形式框架，分析单类型与多类型价值情形下的群结构，推导不变量并比较两种情形的差异，从而识别新的剥削机制。
AI.findings: (1) 单价值类型下，群为阿贝尔群，每个闭合回路上存在唯一不变量——环路亏空，记录流通是否返回。(2) 多价值类型下，群更大，不变量为矩阵和乐的共轭类。(3) 识别出两种新剥削机制：谱机制（和乐行列式为1但各价值类型分别发散/消灭，使聚合闭合标准无法捕捉类型层面的分化）和序列机制（两个相同交换集的不同顺序，在相同汇率与聚合下使贡献者处于不同位置，仅靠排序即可重新分配价值）。(4) 剥削条件在扩大的群上重新表述，加入类型捕获与谱漂移。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出剥削指控的可容许性标准——即对重新描述的对称性不变（invariance under re-description）。(2) 识别谱（spectrum）而非行列式（determinant）为环路中承载类型层面信息的对象。(3) 将交换顺序作为独立的剥削提取场所处理，可通过比较两个相同交换序列来检测，无需观察整个回路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为剥削指控提供了形式化的合法性判据，避免因记账方式差异而导致的指控无效化；同时为多类型价值体系（如多种资源、多种劳动）中的剥削识别提供了新的检测工具（谱分析与序列比较）。

title: The Geometry of Value: Loop Deficits as Invariant Measures of Structural Exploitation

detail.title: The Geometry of Value: Loop Deficits as Invariant Measures of Structural Exploitation
detail.abstract: Every leg of a transfer chain can be defended as fair under some accounting, and the defences are not lies: they are re-descriptions, and re-description is cheap. Disputes about extraction therefore never terminate at a single transaction. This position paper isolates the quantities that survive re-description, by construction. Positions in a transfer network carry valuation frames; transfers carry conversion rates; a change of accounting is a gauge transformation. It is proved that the value assigned to any single leg carries no invariant content, that the entire invariant content of a transfer structure is carried by its closed loops, and that a consistent global measure of value exists exactly when every loop closes. The gauge-invariant observable is the loop deficit: the fraction of registered value lost around a closed circuit, invariant under every admissible re-description and requiring no common unit across kinds of value. The deficit is then mapped onto exploitation, and the mapping is shown to be strict in both directions: a deficit can exist without a wrong, and a wrong can exist at zero deficit. Exploitation is accordingly characterised by three joint structural conditions. A persistent deficit is absorbed at an identifiable position; that position controls the accounting schema; and return to the depleted position is blocked. For these conditions the deficit is the measuring instrument and never the verdict. The principal claim is one of localisation: since no re-description can move the deficit, every persisting dispute about extraction is a dispute about the structure of the network itself, and defences that operate by re-describing individual legs lose their purchase on it. The contribution is threefold: it gives the circulation criterion of generative justice a quantity that can be computed and compared; it explains why attribution disputes conducted at the level of transactions tend not to terminate, since their object carries no invariant content; and it converts the argument about extraction from a contest of accountings into a factual question about the structure of a network. One implication follows directly for platform economies. Computing the invariant requires the record of a whole circuit, which in such economies is ordinarily held by the intermediary alone, so disclosure of circuit-level records is the condition under which any other party can use the instrument at all.

AI.tldr: 本文提出转移网络中的价值核算问题无法在单笔交易层面解决，因为每次重述（re-description）都可以为单条链路的公平性辩护。作者证明：单条腿的价值赋值不携带任何不变内容，整个转移结构的不变内容由闭环承载，且一致的全局价值度量存在当且仅当所有闭环闭合。核心不变可观测量是"回路赤字"（loop deficit），即价值在闭环中流失的比例，它在所有可允许的重新描述下不变，且无需跨价值类型的共同单位。作者将赤字映射到剥削概念，并证明这种映射在两个方向上都是严格的：可以存在赤字而无过错，也可以存在过错而赤字为零。剥削由此由三个联合结构条件刻画：持续赤字被吸收于某一可识别位置、该位置控制核算图式、且返回耗尽位置的通道被阻塞。文章主张"定位性"论点：由于任何重新描述都无法移动赤字，关于攫取的持久争议本质上是关于网络结构本身的争议。贡献有三：为生成正义的流通标准提供可计算可比较的量；解释为何交易层面的归因争议往往无法终止；将攫取辩论从核算之争转化为关于网络结构的事实问题。对平台经济学的直接含义是：计算该不变量的前提是能获得完整回路记录，而这在平台经济中通常仅由中介持有，因此回路级记录的披露是任何其他方使用该工具的前提条件。
AI.research_question: 在价值转移网络中，是否存在不依赖特定核算框架的、衡量价值提取（攫取/剥削）的不变度量？如果能找到这样的度量，如何将其与剥削概念建立严格对应关系？
AI.motivation: 转移链的每一环节都可以在某种核算下被辩护为公平的，且这些辩护并非谎言而是"重新描述"，而重新描述的成本很低。因此关于攫取的争议在单笔交易层面永远不会终结，需要一种在重新描述下保持不变的结构性度量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 规范场论/规范变换（gauge transformation）框架——将会计核算的变更视为规范变换；网络拓扑结构分析——闭环承载不变内容；生成正义（generative justice）的流通标准；剥削理论的结构性条件刻画。
AI.method: 理论分析/立场论文——通过构造证明：证明单条腿的价值赋值不承载不变内容；证明转移结构的全部不变内容由闭环承载；证明一致的全局度量存在当且仅当所有闭环闭合；定义回路赤字为规范不变可观测量；将赤字映射到剥削并证明双向严格性；给出剥削的三个联合结构条件。
AI.findings: （1）单笔交易的估值不承载不变内容，归因争议在该层面无法终止；（2）不变内容由闭环承载，回路赤字是规范不变的、无需共同单位的度量；（3）赤字与剥削的映射是双向严格的：赤字可存在而无过错，过错可存在而赤字为零；（4）剥削由三个联合条件刻画：持续赤字被吸收于可识别位置、该位置控制核算图式、返回耗尽位置被阻塞；（5）赤字是测量工具而非裁决标准；（6）在平台经济中，回路级记录通常仅由中介持有，披露回路级记录是其他方使用该工具的前提。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将生成正义的流通标准转化为可计算可比较的定量度量；（2）解释了为何交易层面的归因争议的不可终止性——因为其对象本身不携带不变内容；（3）将攫取辩论从"核算之争"转化为关于网络结构的事实性问题；（4）将规范场论思想引入价值核算与剥削理论，提供跨学科的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为生成正义和剥削检测提供可计算、可比较的定量工具（回路赤字）；（2）为平台经济中的核算透明度提供理论依据——回路级记录的披露是其他方使用该度量工具的前提条件；（3）为价值提取争议的解决提供结构化路径：将争议引导到网络结构层面而非单笔交易层面。

title: Rethinking "Rethinking": A Mechanism of Truth Emergence through Historical Evolution

detail.title: Rethinking "Rethinking": A Mechanism of Truth Emergence through Historical Evolution
detail.abstract: Calls to rethink an established concept, theory or institution ordinarily proceed by criticising an inherited framework and offering a successor. The successor then occupies the position the predecessor vacated, and the historicity that grounded the criticism is quietly withheld from the criticising position. This paper treats that pattern as a structural feature of critique and offers an account of what makes rethinking recur. The account has three parts. The conditions under which a relation can be observed, articulated, tested and contested are materially and institutionally produced, and they vary with instruments, infrastructures, forms of labour and the organisation of inquiry; the relation itself obtains independently of those conditions, so a failure of recognition is a fact about the situation of describers. The enlargement of what can be recognised carries no guarantee of direction, since recognition can be lost, suppressed, distorted and absorbed into institutional form. From these two together it follows that revisability belongs to the structure of any historically grounded claim, and that a course which irreversibly forecloses the conditions of future recognition carries a burden of justification that a revisable course does not carry. The paper concedes its principal ancestors directly. That historical conditions introduce new candidates for truth and falsehood is owed to Hacking; that a lived relation can go unrecognised for want of collective interpretive resources is owed to Fricker; the distinction between the changing knowledge of an object and the object known is owed to Bhaskar. What the paper adds is a materialist account of the conditions of recognition, an insistence that the relation remains independent of them, and the forward-looking obligation that follows. On the question whether the historicity of the standards of appraisal collapses into relativism the paper declines to adjudicate, and states the material conditions under which each of the available resolutions became formulable, on the ground that a framework asserting the historicity of answers owes the same treatment to answers it would like to give itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"反思"（rethinking）作为一种结构性特征的元理论解释，认为任何历史性主张都内在地具有可修正性（revisability），并论证了不可逆地关闭未来认知条件的路径比可修正路径承担更重的辩护负担。
AI.research_question: 为什么"反思"（对既有概念、理论或制度的重新思考）会反复发生？其结构性条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统的"反思"遵循"批评旧框架—提供新框架"的模式，但新框架随后占据旧框架的位置，批评所依赖的历史性（historicity）却被悄悄地从批评立场中抽离。作者认为这种模式是批评的结构性特征，需要解释其为何反复出现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要承袭三个思想资源：Hacking关于历史条件引入新的真/假候选命题的观点；Fricker关于集体解释资源缺失导致生活关系未被认识的观点；Bhaskar关于对象的知识变化与对象本身之区分（批判实在论）。
AI.method: 概念分析与哲学论证，以三部分构成的理论框架展开：（1）认知条件由物质与制度性生产；（2）关系独立于认知条件而存在，认识失败是描述者处境的属性；（3）从两者推出可修正性属于任何历史性主张的结构，并推导出不逆转向关闭认知条件的路径具有更重的辩护责任。
AI.findings: 1. 认知的条件（观察、表述、检验、争议）由物质和制度性地产生，随工具、基础设施、劳动形式和研究组织方式而变化；2. 关系本身独立于这些条件，故未获承认是描述者处境的属性；3. 认知扩展无方向保证，认知可被丢失、压制、扭曲或吸收进制度形式；4. 由此推出可修正性属于任何历史主张的结构，不可逆关闭未来认知条件的路径承担更重辩护负担。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出对认知条件的唯物主义解释，坚持关系独立于认知条件，并推导出前瞻性的义务（对不可逆路径施加更重辩护负担）。对标准之历史性是否陷入相对主义的问题拒绝裁决，转而说明每种解决方案可表述的物质条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估政策路径、制度改革和知识实践提供规范性判准：凡不可逆地排除未来认知条件的决策需要更严格的辩护；为学术批评实践提供元理论反思，提示批评者需检视自身立场的历史条件。

title: The Divisive Index: A Distribution-based Measure of Polarization in Opinion Ratings

detail.title: The Divisive Index: A Distribution-based Measure of Polarization in Opinion Ratings

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: Author declares that no external funding was received for this research

detail.abstract: This paper introduces a distribution-based metric, the Divisive Index (DI), for assessing two-cluster distributional polarization in ordered rating data. The index measures the extent to which an observed rating distribution can be represented by two separated, internally concentrated, and comparably sized opinion clusters. DI combines three components: Separation (S), the standardized distance between fitted opinion clusters; Prominence (P), the relative depletion of density between fitted peaks; and Balance (B), the comparability of the fitted cluster masses. Using a two-component Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM-2) and a bounded transformation, DI yields an interpretable score between 0 and 1, where higher values indicate stronger two-cluster distributional polarization. Empirical examples based on movie-rating data illustrate how the index summarizes separation, valley depth, and balance. Benchmark and theoretical cases further show how DI differs from ordinary dispersion measures, beta-distribution fitting, Van der Eijk-style agreement measures, and other polarization frameworks. A separate exploratory extension is proposed for multimodal distributions, where adjacent-pair cleavages can be assessed locally and aggregated into a multimodal cleavage score. The paper presents DI as a practical and interpretable research framework rather than a fully validated classification instrument; further work is needed to establish thresholds, sensitivity, robustness, and domain-specific applicability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于分布的度量指标——分化指数（DI），用于评估有序评级数据中的双簇分布极化现象。DI结合分离度、显著性和平衡性三个分量，通过双组分高斯混合模型和有界变换生成0到1之间的可解释分数，较高值表示更强的双簇分布极化。论文还提出多模态分布的探索性扩展，并强调该指标作为实用研究框架而非完全验证的分类工具。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够有效衡量有序评级数据中双簇分布极化的分布型度量指标？
AI.motivation: 现有度量方法（如普通离散度指标、Beta分布拟合、Van der Eijk式一致性度量等）无法充分刻画两极化意见簇的分离、内部集中及规模可比性，需要一种更直观且可解释的极化度量框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双组分高斯混合模型（GMM-2）、有界变换、分布极化理论框架
AI.method: 提出分化指数（DI），融合三个分量：分离度（S，拟合意见簇之间的标准化距离）、显著性（P，拟合峰之间密度的相对匮乏程度）和平衡性（B，拟合簇质量的可比性）。采用双组分高斯混合模型及有界变换进行拟合，输出0-1之间的分数。
AI.findings: 基于电影评分数据的实证示例展示该指数能有效概括分离度、谷深和平衡性；基准与理论案例表明DI与普通离散度指标、Beta分布拟合、Van der Eijk式一致性度量及其他极化框架存在明显差异；针对多模态分布提出局部评估相邻簇间裂痕并聚合为多模态裂痕分数的探索性扩展。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一种新型的分布极化度量框架，将分离性、内部集中性和规模可比性三个维度整合为统一指标，并区分于现有极化与一致性度量范式，为有序评级数据的极化研究提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电影评分等有序评级数据分析提供直观可解释的量化工具；适用于社交媒体意见极化、消费者评价等领域的两极化程度监测与比较；多模态扩展为更复杂的意见分布结构分析提供基础。

title: Bodily Subsidised Development: Global Value Chains and the Politics of the Body in China and Vietnam

detail.title: Bodily Subsidised Development: Global Value Chains and the Politics of the Body in China and Vietnam
detail.abstract: Global value chains (GVCs) are frequently understood as pathways through which developing economies can achieve industrial upgrading, employment growth, and greater integration into global markets. Yet such accounts often privilege firms, states, and aggregate economic indicators while obscuring the embodied conditions through which development is produced. This paper examines GVC-led development through the politics of the body, comparing the electronics industries of China and Vietnam. It argues that economic upgrading is inseparable from the unequal organisation of labouring bodies across firms, regions, and national borders. China's integration into electronics GVCs has enabled substantial industrial upgrading, while relying heavily on the disciplined and intensive labour of migrant workers. As production costs have risen in China, labour-intensive activities have increasingly been relocated to Vietnam, where lower wages and a comparatively flexible labour force provide new conditions for accumulation. The paper conceptualises this process as bodily subsidised development : development whose apparent economic gains depend partly upon bodily costs-exhaustion, discipline, precarity, and disposability-that remain inadequately captured by conventional measures of upgrading. GVCs, therefore, do not simply generate development; they produce differentiated development in which the mobility of firms, capital, and some workers may depend upon the constrained mobility and embodied costs borne by others.

AI.tldr: 本文通过"身体政治"的视角审视全球价值链（GVCs）驱动的发展，比较中国与越南电子产业的案例，提出"身体补贴型发展"（bodily subsidised development）概念，论证经济升级与劳动身体的不平等组织密不可分——中国依靠移民工人的高强度纪律化劳动实现产业升级，而随着成本上升，劳动密集型活动转移到越南，其低工资与弹性劳动力为资本积累提供新条件。GVCs并非简单地产生发展，而是产生了差异化的发展，其中企业、资本和部分工人的流动性可能依赖于他人受限的流动性和所承担的身体成本。
AI.research_question: 全球价值链驱动的发展如何通过身体政治（politics of the body）得以实现？中国与越南电子产业的升级过程中，劳动身体的组织如何构成发展的必要条件？
AI.motivation: 现有关于全球价值链与发展关系的论述往往偏重企业、国家和总体经济指标，忽视了发展得以生产的具体身体条件（embodied conditions）。本文旨在弥补这一缺口，从身体政治的角度揭示经济升级背后不平等的劳动身体组织。
AI.theoretical_framework: 身体政治（politics of the body）；全球价值链理论；劳动过程理论；批判发展研究；身体补贴型发展（bodily subsidised development）概念框架
AI.method: 比较案例研究：对比中国与越南电子产业在全球价值链中的整合、升级路径及劳动身体的组织方式。
AI.findings: （1）中国电子产业的成功升级高度依赖移民工人高强度、纪律化的劳动；（2）随着中国生产成本上升，劳动密集型环节向越南转移，越南以更低工资和更灵活的劳动力提供新的积累条件；（3）发展被认为具有"身体补贴"性质——表面上的经济收益部分依赖于疲惫、纪律、不稳定性和可弃置性等身体成本，而这些成本未被传统的升级指标充分捕捉；（4）GVCs产生的是差异化的发展，企业、资本及部分工人的流动性以牺牲他人受限的流动性和身体成本为前提。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"身体补贴型发展"（bodily subsidised development）这一核心概念，将身体政治引入全球价值链与发展的分析框架，挑战仅以经济指标衡量升级的既有范式，揭示了升级与身体不平等之间的内在关联。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者和发展机构关注全球价值链发展模式中被忽视的劳动力身体成本，警示以劳动剥削为代价的产业升级路径的可持续性问题，为全球南方产业政策提供批判性反思。

title: Bridging the Human-AI Readiness Gap in Marketing: Introducing the HACR Framework

detail.abstract: As AI adoption accelerates, marketing's biggest roadblock isn't the technology-it's the team. This paper introduces the Human-AI Collaboration Readiness (HACR) Framework, a conceptually grounded, practice-tested model distilled from 15 leading academic and industry sources. HACR identifies four critical levers-Role Clarity, Agile Workflows, Continuous Upskilling, and Cross-Functional Collaboration-that determine whether AI becomes embedded or estranged. Unlike infrastructure-heavy maturity indices, HACR focuses on team dynamics and operational agility. It equips CMOs with a strategic diagnostic lens and offers researchers a scalable blueprint to advance human-AI synergy in real-world marketing environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Human-AI Collaboration Readiness (HACR)框架，从15个顶级学术和行业来源中提炼出四个关键杠杆（角色清晰度、敏捷工作流、持续技能提升和跨职能协作），帮助营销团队评估和提升AI整合就绪度，弥补传统技术导向成熟度模型的不足。
AI.research_question: 在AI采用加速的背景下，营销团队成功整合AI的关键组织驱动因素是什么？如何构建一个聚焦团队动态而非基础设施的评估框架？
AI.motivation: 尽管AI技术发展迅速，营销组织在AI落地中最主要的障碍不是技术本身，而是团队能力与协作机制。现有成熟度指数过于侧重基础设施，忽视了团队动态和运营敏捷性这一关键维度。
AI.theoretical_framework: HACR框架基于15个领先学术和行业来源的概念综合，涵盖角色清晰度（Role Clarity）、敏捷工作流（Agile Workflows）、持续技能提升（Continuous Upskilling）和跨职能协作（Cross-Functional Collaboration）四大理论维度。
AI.method: 基于15个学术和行业来源的概念性蒸馏与综合，构建实践检验的框架模型。
AI.findings: HACR框架识别出决定AI在营销团队中是"嵌入"还是"疏离"的四个关键杠杆：角色清晰度、敏捷工作流、持续技能提升和跨职能协作。
AI.theory_contributions: 摒弃基础设施密集型的成熟度指数范式，提出聚焦团队动态和运营敏捷性的概念框架，为研究者提供可扩展的蓝图以推进真实营销环境中的人机协同研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为首席营销官（CMOs）提供战略诊断视角，帮助其评估和提升团队AI整合就绪度。

title: Do Actions Match Words? Reassessing The Taylor Rule in an Emerging-Market Context
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston and Indira Gandhi Institute of Development Research (IGIDR)

detail.title: Do Actions Match Words? Reassessing The Taylor Rule in an Emerging-Market Context
detail.abstract: Backward-looking Taylor rules, widely used to characterize central bank behavior, can misrepresent policy when central banks base decisions on forecasts. This mischaracterization affects the assessment of credibility, defined as alignment between a central bank's words and actions. We examine this issue in the context of India's adoption of flexible inflation targeting (FIT) in 2015. Text analysis shows that the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) communication became more inflation-focused and forward-looking after FIT adoption. Yet backward-looking Taylor rules show no robust increase in responsiveness to realized inflation, suggesting lack of credibility. This misalignment disappears when we analyze policy-relevant information through a forward-looking lens. Using the RBI's real-time inflation and output forecasts, we find significant responsiveness to expected inflation post-FIT. Hybrid reaction functions show that post-FIT policy responds to both expected and realized inflation. The analogous evolution in communication and conduct points to the RBI's credibility. More broadly, our results demonstrate that hybrid reaction functions may better characterize emerging-market central bank behavior than purely backward-or forward-looking specifications.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析印度央行2015年采纳灵活通胀目标制（FIT）前后的沟通与政策行为，发现传统后退式泰勒规则无法准确刻画前瞻型央行的政策反应，而采用混合反应函数（同时包含预期与实际通胀）后，印度央行的沟通与行为呈现出一致的前瞻性，从而证明了其可信度。
AI.research_question: 当中央银行基于预测而非实际通胀制定政策时，后退式泰勒规则是否会误判其政策行为，进而导致对央行可信度的错误评估？
AI.motivation: 后退式泰勒规则是刻画央行行为的常用工具，但如果央行实际采用前瞻性决策模式，该规则将错误表征政策，从而影响对央行可信度（言行一致性）的评估。印度2015年采纳FIT提供了检验这一问题的自然实验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 泰勒规则（后退式与前瞻式）、中央银行可信度理论、混合反应函数、文本分析方法。
AI.method: 结合文本分析（解析RBI沟通文件中的通胀关注度与前瞻性措辞）与计量经济分析（估计后退式、前瞻式及混合泰勒规则反应函数，使用RBI的实时通胀与产出预测数据）。
AI.findings: （1）FIT采纳后，RBI的沟通变得更加通胀导向且更具前瞻性；（2）后退式泰勒规则未显示政策对已实现通胀的稳健响应增强，看似缺乏可信度；（3）采用前瞻式视角后，发现FIT采纳后政策对预期通胀有显著响应；（4）混合反应函数显示FIT后政策同时响应预期通胀与实际通胀；（5）沟通与行为的前瞻性演变一致，表明RBI具有可信度。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明后退式泰勒规则可能系统性误判前瞻型央行的政策反应和可信度；提出混合反应函数（同时包含前瞻与后退成分）可能比纯前瞻或纯后退规格更能刻画新兴市场央行行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估新兴市场央行政策可信度提供了更准确的分析框架；对印度及其他采纳通胀目标制央行的政策制定与沟通策略具有参考价值。

title: Moral Hazard and Disappointment Aversion
affiliations: Hebrew University of Jerusalem, University of Bonn - Chair of Economic Theory II and Yale, Department of Economics

detail.title: Moral Hazard and Disappointment Aversion
detail.abstract: We study the classical moral-hazard problem with hidden actions where both the agent and the principal are disappointment-(and risk-) averse in the sense of Gul [1991] and have a piece-wise linear utility over monetary outcomes. The optimal contract for the case where only the agent is disappointment averse consists of three levels of payment: a standard fixed wage-equivalent to the agent's total perceived compensation including bonus and penalties-for middle outcomes, a (possible random) penalty wage/termination clause for low outcomes, and a bonus paid only for the highest outcome. This structure is commonly observed in practice and is in sharp contrast both to the results obtained under expected utility (e.g., complex schemes that finely depend on the model's primitives) and under other departures from expected utility (e.g., binary bonus schemes under loss aversion a la Köszegi-Rabin [2006]). When both agent and principal are disappointmentand risk-averse, the optimal contract continues to be piece-wise linear with some discrete jumps but consists of five distinct parts: the penalty/basic wage/bonus scheme described above and, in addition, two separate areas where the agent's pay is linearly increasing in outcome.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了委托人和代理人都是失望厌恶（且风险厌恶）的道德风险问题。当仅代理人为失望厌恶时，最优合约包含三层支付结构：固定工资、惩罚性工资/解雇条款和高额奖金；当双方均为失望厌恶时，最优合约扩展为五部分的分段线性结构。
AI.research_question: 在失望厌恶偏好（Gul, 1991）下，隐藏行动道德风险问题的最优合约结构是什么？当代理人和委托人双方均为失望厌恶时，最优合约如何变化？
AI.motivation: 传统期望效用框架下推导出的最优合约极为复杂且依赖于模型参数，与实际观察到的简单合约结构不符。而其他非期望效用偏好（如Köszegi-Rabin损失厌恶）预测二元奖金方案，也未能完全解释实践中常见的三层支付结构（固定工资+惩罚+奖金）。失望厌恶作为一种重要的非期望效用偏好，可能为实际合约结构提供更合理的解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 失望厌恶理论（Gul, 1991）——决策者参考点是自身期望效用，低于预期结果会产生失望心理成本；结合风险厌恶与分块线性效用函数（piece-wise linear utility）构建道德风险模型。
AI.method: 理论建模与数学推导。构建委托-代理模型，代理人行动隐藏，双方具有失望厌恶和风险厌恶偏好，效用函数为分段线性，求解最优合约设计问题。
AI.findings: （1）仅代理人为失望厌恶时，最优合约为三层支付结构：中期结果对应固定工资（含总体感知补偿），低结果对应惩罚性工资或解雇条款（可能随机化），最高结果支付奖金。（2）双方均为失望厌恶时，最优合约仍为分段线性并带有离散跳跃，但扩展为五部分：惩罚/基本工资/奖金结构之外，增加两个结果区间内支付随产出线性递增的区域。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次将失望厌恶引入道德风险问题，证明了在失望厌恶下最优合约为简单的三层/五层分段结构，与期望效用框架下复杂合约形成鲜明对比。（2）区分了失望厌恶与损失厌恶（Köszegi-Rabin）在合约设计上的不同预测，丰富了非期望效用偏好下合约理论的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为实践中广泛观察到的"基本工资+奖金+惩罚/解雇"三层薪酬结构提供了理论基础。（2）为企业在双方均存在失望厌恶时的薪酬合约设计提供指导，揭示了最优合约应包含五个组成部分的设计原则。

title: Out-of-the-Loop in Maritime Autonomous Systems: Legal Implications of Reduced Human Oversight

detail.title: Out-of-the-Loop in Maritime Autonomous Systems: Legal Implications of Reduced Human Oversight
detail.abstract: The growing deployment of Maritime Autonomous Surface Ships (M.A.S.S.) is transforming the human role in navigation from direct operator to remote supervisor, a shift that existing liability frameworks have yet to fully address This article argues that conventional negligence frameworks, premised on an embodied operator maintaining continuous attention, incorrectly attribute fault where incidents involving M.A.S.S. arise from the architecture of remote supervision rather than from the conduct of any individual supervisor. Diminished situational awareness and system-induced cognitive overload progressively undermine the supervisor's practical ability to identify and address anomalies within the time required for effective intervention. Against this background, the article develops a T0-T6 framework that maps the temporal progression from the emergence of an anomaly to the implementation of corrective action, thereby providing a basis for distinguishing, on a case-by-case basis, between supervisory negligence and failures attributable to system design. The framework is subsequently applied to assess the limits of existing liability doctrines, including those reflected in the EU's revised Product Liability Directive. The article concludes by outlining, at a theoretical level, a contextualised standard of care and a liability framework oriented towards identifying the point in the temporal sequence at which a given failure originates.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了海事自主水面船舶（M.A.S.S.）的部署如何将人类角色从直接操作者转变为远程监督者，并指出传统过失责任框架无法充分应对这一转变。文章提出了一个T0-T6时间框架，用于区分监督过失与系统设计缺陷，并评估现有责任理论的局限，最后提出了情境化的注意标准和以故障来源时间点为导向的责任框架。
AI.research_question: 现有过失责任框架如何适应海事自主水面船舶（M.A.S.S.）中远程监督者的角色转变？当事故源于远程监督架构而非个别监督者的行为时，应如何归责？
AI.motivation: M.A.S.S.的日益部署正在改变人类在航行中的角色（从直接操作者到远程监督者），但现有责任框架尚未充分解决这一转变。传统过失框架以"具身操作者持续保持注意力"为前提，无法正确处理源于远程监督架构而非个人行为的事故归责问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传统过失责任理论（以具身操作者持续注意力为前提）、T0-T6时间框架（从异常出现到纠正行动实施的时间演进映射）、欧盟修订版产品责任指令中体现的责任理论。
AI.method: 概念性/规范性法学分析方法：提出T0-T6时间框架作为分析工具，并应用于评估现有责任理论（包括欧盟产品责任指令）的适用性。
AI.findings: 1) 传统过失框架在M.A.S.S.场景下会错误归责；2) T0-T6框架可为个案区分监督过失与系统设计缺陷提供依据；3) 远程监督中情境感知减弱和系统引发的认知过载会逐渐削弱监督者的有效干预能力；4) 现有责任理论（包括欧盟修订版产品责任指令）存在局限。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了T0-T6时间框架作为新的分析工具，用于在自主航运背景下区分人类监督者责任与系统设计责任；提出将注意标准情境化，并以故障在时间序列中的起源点为导向构建责任框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为海事自主船舶领域的法律实践提供了责任分配的分析框架，有助于在具体案件中判断责任归属；对欧盟产品责任指令的修订提供了理论层面的评估和参考。

title: Early Warning Signals in Private Credit? What BDC Portfolios Reveal about Emerging Risks
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston, Federal Reserve Bank of Boston and Federal Reserve Bank of Boston

detail.title: Early Warning Signals in Private Credit? What BDC Portfolios Reveal about Emerging Risks
detail.abstract: Our analysis produces a detailed picture of middle-market lending conditions that can inform assessments of the broader private credit market. It shows that payment-in-kind (PIK) usage has increased steadily since 2022.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了中等市场贷款条件，指出自2022年以来实物支付（PIK）的使用持续增加，为评估更广泛的私人信贷市场提供了详细图景。
AI.research_question: 中等市场贷款条件呈现出怎样的变化趋势，特别是实物支付（PIK）的使用情况如何演变？
AI.motivation: 需要深入理解中等市场贷款条件的变化，以便为更广泛的私人信贷市场评估提供信息支撑，尤其是PIK使用增长这一值得关注的趋势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 私人信贷市场理论及贷款结构分析框架。
AI.method: 对中等市场贷款数据进行实证分析，追踪PIK使用的时间序列变化。
AI.findings: 自2022年以来，实物支付（PIK）的使用持续稳步增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 为私人信贷市场研究提供了关于中等市场贷款条件的系统性证据，揭示了PIK使用增长这一重要结构性变化。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于投资者、监管机构及市场参与者更全面地评估私人信贷市场的风险状况，尤其是在PIK使用增加的背景下关注潜在的信用风险。

title: Wrongfully Incarcerated, Wrongfully Taxed
affiliations: Pace University - School of Law and Milbank LLP

detail.title: Wrongfully Incarcerated, Wrongfully Taxed
detail.abstract:
Incarcerated for over twenty years. Proven to be wrongfully convicted. Taxed on the transfer of any wealth to the next generation. This is the current state of the law for those who receive wrongful conviction awards, and it should be changed. In 2015, Congress passed a law to exclude wrongful-incarceration compensation from federal income tax. The provision only does part of the job; notable gaps remain.

      First, the statute is silent about the income tax consequences if an exoneree dies before the award is paid. Second, if the award is not consumed during lifetime, the exoneree's estate may be subject to estate taxes. The timing of death thus can decide whether the government recaptures part of the compensation it pays for its own wrongdoing. 

      This Article supplies model statutory text to make two narrow amendments to the tax law: clarifying that IRC § 139F excludes from gross income amounts received by an exoneree's estate and excluding wrongful-incarceration compensation from the estate tax. More broadly, the current tax treatment of wrongful-incarceration awards exposes a structural flaw in the tax base: a system built on accessions to wealth has no coherent way to treat compensation for state-inflicted harm to interests that it does not tax in the first place, such as personal liberty.

AI.tldr: 本文指出司法赔偿（错误定罪赔偿金）在联邦所得税和遗产税方面的现行法律存在缺陷，并通过提供示范法条文建议对税法进行两项狭窄修订：明确IRC第139F条涵盖被冤者遗产所得的赔偿金，以及将错误定罪赔偿金排除在遗产税之外。文章进一步揭示了一个更深层的结构性缺陷：以财富增值为基础的税收体系无法连贯地处理对政府侵害个人自由等未被征税利益的国家赔偿。
AI.research_question: 错误定罪赔偿金在当前税法下的税收处理存在哪些漏洞？应如何通过立法修订来完善？这一问题的背后反映了税收基础的何种结构性缺陷？
AI.motivation: 2015年国会通过法律将错误定罪赔偿金排除在联邦所得税之外，但该规定存在明显缺口：一是条文未明确被冤者死亡后赔偿金支付给遗产时的所得税后果；二是赔偿金若未在其生前消费，遗产可能面临遗产税。这意味着死亡时间可能决定政府能否收回其自身错误行为所支付的赔偿金的一部分，这显然不合理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以财富增值（accessions to wealth）为基础的税收体系理论。该理论框架揭示了一个结构性矛盾：税收体系建立在财富增值基础上，但对于政府侵害的非税利益（如个人自由）的赔偿，体系缺乏连贯的处理方式——因为这类利益本身从未被征税，其赔偿金是否应纳入税基成为一个理论难题。
AI.method: 法规文本分析方法，通过提供示范法条文（model statutory text）提出具体的立法修订方案。文章分析现行IRC第139F条的文本漏洞，并结合遗产税法的交叉适用问题，提出两项狭窄而精确的修订建议。
AI.findings: 发现两个主要法律漏洞：(1) IRC第139F条未明确被冤者死亡后由遗产收到的赔偿金是否排除在应税所得之外；(2) 错误定罪赔偿金在遗产税层面未获豁免，可能在遗产转移时被政府部分回收。更深层地，文章揭示税收体系对政府侵权的赔偿缺乏连贯的理论框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了以财富增值为基础的税制对政府侵权行为赔偿的结构性缺陷：对于未被征税的利益（如人身自由）的损害补偿，税制缺乏自洽的处理理论。这一发现丰富了税收基础理论的讨论，尤其是关于税基边界与国家赔偿责任交叉的学术探讨。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供具体的示范法条文文本，供立法者采纳，以弥补IRC第139F条的文本漏洞并增加遗产税豁免。这为被错误定罪者及其家庭提供了明确的法律保障，确保政府不会因其自身的司法错误而从赔偿金中回收税款。

title: Procurement beyond the Bid: Cost Overruns, Verification, and Contractor Default
affiliations: Monash University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Procurement beyond the Bid: Cost Overruns, Verification, and Contractor Default
detail.abstract: Procurement competition selects both a price and a way of resolving later cost shocks.  We study this joint mechanism when completion cost is privately observed, claims require costly verification, and contractors have limited financial capacity.  The post-award contract features unaudited completion, audited cost sharing, and replacement.  Its operating payoff changes auction accounting: optimal selection ranks complete continuation contracts rather than award prices alone.  Although this ranking need not admit a fixed score, a menu auction with a second-score transfer rule implements the direct optimum in ex post equilibrium.  Price-only competition can instead select fragility. More bidders may lower the winning bid while increasing contractor default and expected fiscal cost.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了采购竞争如何同时选择价格和解决后期成本冲击的方式。当完工成本为私人信息、索赔需要昂贵验证且承包商财务能力有限时，最优合同包含未经审计的完工、经审计的成本分担和替换机制。该合同的运营收益改变了拍卖会计：最优选择是对完整继续合同进行排序，而非仅按中标价格排序。虽然这种排序不一定能被固定分数表示，但采用第二分数转移规则的菜单拍卖能在事后均衡中实现直接最优。纯价格竞争可能选择脆弱性：更多投标人可能降低中标价，同时增加承包商违约和预期财政成本。
AI.research_question: 在存在私人完工成本、昂贵验证和承包商财务约束的情况下，采购竞争如何同时筛选价格与事后成本冲击的解决机制？
AI.motivation: 现有采购文献通常将价格竞争与事后合同执行分开研究，忽视了拍卖与合同设计之间的联合机制。实践中承包商违约和成本超支问题普遍存在，价格最低者未必是最优选择，需要理解竞争结构如何影响合同表现与财政成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机制设计理论、拍卖理论、不完全合同理论、成本验证与审计理论
AI.method: 理论建模：构建包含私人成本信息、昂贵验证和财务约束的采购拍卖模型，比较直接最优机制与菜单拍卖实施，并分析纯价格竞争的均衡结果。
AI.findings: （1）最优的授予后合同包含未经审计的完工、经审计的成本分担与替换机制；（2）最优选择应基于完整继续合同的运营收益排序而非仅看中标价格；（3）菜单拍卖配合第二分数转移规则可在事后均衡中实施直接最优；（4）纯价格竞争可能选出脆弱合同——更多投标人可能降低中标价格，但同时增加承包商违约风险和预期财政成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 将拍卖竞争与事后合同设计纳入统一框架，证明最优拍卖排序对象是完整合同而非单一价格，并说明了固定分数排序的局限性及菜单拍卖的替代实施路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府采购和招投标实践提供了新的评标思路：应综合评价合同完整性而非仅比价；警示纯价格竞争可能导致投标人数增加反而恶化财政风险的反直觉后果。

title:
Automation Follows Observability 
Why Residential Real Estate Is Already Priced by Machines and Institutional Real Estate Is Not

detail.title:
Automation Follows Observability 
Why Residential Real Estate Is Already Priced by Machines and Institutional Real Estate Is Not

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an independent researcher and a licensed California real estate professional whose business includes residential brokerage. The author purchases referral leads from Zillow Group, Inc., a company whose data and conduct are discussed at length in this paper, and therefore has an ongoing commercial relationship with one of the entities the paper analyzes. The author holds no equity, debt, or derivative position in Zillow Group, CoStar Group, Opendoor Technologies, Blackstone, Starwood Capital, or any other entity named in this paper, and has no consulting, advisory, or board relationship with any of them. No entity named in the paper funded, reviewed, or was given advance access to this work. The paper relies exclusively on publicly available sources. No proprietary, licensed, or subscription data was used.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study involved no human participants, no animal subjects, and no personal or identifiable data. It is a synthesis of publicly available secondary sources: regulatory filings, government data releases, index publications, industry survey reports, and the peer-reviewed literature. No ethics approval or informed consent was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no funding from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit agency. It was conducted independently by the author, without institutional support, research assistance, or sponsorship.

detail.abstract: The standard account of automated investment decision-making treats it as a technology-diusion problem: models improve, computing gets cheaper, and automation spreads on a schedule set by capability. This paper argues the schedule is set by something else. Automation diuses in proportion to the observability of an asset, meaning the frequency, publicity, and standardization of its price record, and is largely indierent to available computing power. US real estate is an unusually clean test, containing both extremes of the observability distribution inside one asset class, in the same era, among substantially the same rms. Assembling public series across the two halves of the market, I document that automated valuation and underwriting have operated at national scale in residential lending since the mid-1990s. Sixty-two percent of conventional closed loans market-wide were reviewed by Fannie Mae's Desktop Underwriter over 2018-2024, and 28 percent of GSE acquisitions in March 2026 carried an appraisal waiver. Institutional real estate, by contrast, still sets its marks by rotating annual external appraisal, with the adviser computing NAV in a material share of non-traded vehicles. Asset heterogeneity does not explain the gap: houses are heterogeneous too, and they were automated rst. The discriminating variable is the transaction record. The cleanest measurement is internal to one model: Zillow's Zestimate had a median absolute error of 1.8 percent for listed homes and 7.2 percent for o-market homes in 2025, the same model applied to the same housing stock with and without a published asking price. I argue further that the observability gradient is endogenous to the fee structure of private funds, which implies the timing of automation there is a question about liquidity events and regulatory intervention rather than model releases.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了自动化投资决策的"技术扩散"标准叙事，提出自动化扩散的速度取决于资产的"可观测性"（价格记录的频率、公开性和标准化程度），而非计算能力。作者以美国房地产为自然实验，发现住宅贷款领域自1990年代中期起已实现全国范围的自动化估值与承销，而机构房地产仍依赖年度外部评估，其根本差异在于交易记录的可观测性，而非资产异质性。
AI.research_question: 自动化投资决策的扩散速度由什么决定？是可用的计算能力，还是资产的可观测性（价格记录的频率、公开性与标准化程度）？
AI.motivation: 标准理论将自动化扩散视为技术能力提升的函数（模型进步、成本下降、自动化的扩散由能力决定的时间表），但该理论无法解释同一资产类别内部、同一时代、同一批公司中出现截然不同的自动化水平。作者需要寻找一个能区分两种解释的干净检验场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可观测性假说：自动化的扩散与资产价格记录的可观测性（频率、公开性、标准化程度）成正比，而与计算能力基本无关。可观测性是私募基金费用结构的内生变量，因此机构房地产自动化时序取决于流动性事件和监管干预而非模型发布。
AI.method: 自然实验法：利用美国房地产市场作为检验场景——同一资产类别中存在可观测性的两个极端（住宅与商业地产/机构房地产）。汇编公开序列数据，衡量住宅领域自动化估值与承销的覆盖率（Fannie Mae Desktop Underwriter的使用比例、GSE评估豁免比例），对比机构房地产仍依赖人工年度评估的现状，并使用Zillow Zestimate模型内部对照（同一模型对挂牌与非挂牌房产的误差差异）来分离资产异质性与可观测性的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 1990年代中期起，住宅贷款领域已实现全国规模的自动化估值与承销；2018-2024年间，62%的常规封闭贷款经Fannie Mae Desktop Underwriter审查，2026年3月28%的GSE收购带有评估豁免。2) 机构房地产仍以年度外部评估设定价格，非上市工具中大量份额由顾问计算NAV。3) 资产异质性不解释差距（房屋同样异质却被先自动化）。4) Zillow Zestimate的中位绝对误差在挂牌房产为1.8%，非挂牌房产为7.2%——同一模型、同一住房存量，仅凭有无公开挂牌价。5) 可观测性梯度是私募基金费用结构的内生结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并实证支持"可观测性假说"作为自动化扩散的新理论解释，取代"技术能力"标准叙事；将自动化时序的研究焦点从技术供给端转向信息基础设施与市场制度结构；论证可观测性梯度与私募基金费用结构的内生关系，为自动化扩散理论增加了制度与激励维度的分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 对机构房地产投资管理者而言，本文指明自动化的推进应聚焦于提升交易的流动性、创造标准化的公开价格记录；对监管者而言，提示通过流动性事件和监管干预可以改变可观测性梯度从而加速自动化；对技术开发者而言，表明模型能力并非扩散的瓶颈，数据基础设施才是。

title: Social Economy and the Housing Crisis: European Practices and Public Policy
affiliations: University of West Attica (UNIWA) - Department of Business Administration

detail.title: Social Economy and the Housing Crisis: European Practices and Public Policy

declarations.ethicsApproval: NO ETHICAL ISSUES
declarations.funderStatement: NO

detail.abstract:
The housing crisis has emerged in recent years as one of Europe's most significant social and political challenges, with direct implications for social protection, social cohesion, and urban sustainability. Rising housing costs, the financialisation of real estate, and the limited supply of affordable housing are intensifying housing insecurity and social exclusion, particularly among young people, low-and middleincome households, and vulnerable social groups. Against this background, the article examines the social economy as a complementary mechanism of social protection in housing, focusing on socially oriented and non-profit models developed across Europe. 

The study is based on a qualitative and comparative public policy approach and uses bibliographic and institutional analysis of European social housing practices. In particular, the cases of Vienna, Brussels, Barcelona and Zurich are examined, highlighting different forms of socially oriented housing, such as municipal and non-profit housing, Community Land Trusts, collaborative housing schemes and cooperative housing ecosystems. 

The article also examines Greece, identifying both the limitations of current housing policy and the institutional scope for more collective and socially oriented forms of housing through the use of public and municipal property and cooperation with social economy entities. It argues that, although the social economy cannot replace the welfare state or public housing policy, it can complement them by fostering social innovation, collective governance, and social cohesion in housing.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨社会经济作为住房领域社会保护补充机制的作用，通过比较分析欧洲（维也纳、布鲁塞尔、巴塞罗那、苏黎世）的社会导向型住房模式（市政/非营利住房、社区土地信托、合作住房等），并审视希腊住房政策的局限与制度空间，论证社会经济虽不能替代福利国家和公共住房政策，但可通过促进社会创新、集体治理和社会凝聚来补充之。
AI.research_question: 社会经济如何作为住房领域社会保护的补充机制？不同欧洲城市的社会导向型住房模式有何特征？希腊住房政策存在哪些局限及制度空间？
AI.motivation: 欧洲住房危机日益严峻，住房成本上升、房地产金融化和经济适用住房供给不足加剧了住房不安全和社会排斥，尤其影响年轻人、中低收入家庭和弱势群体，亟需探索超越传统公共政策的补充性住房保护机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会保护理论（补充性保护机制）、社会经济学理论、福利国家与公共政策理论、社会创新与集体治理理论
AI.method: 定性比较公共政策方法，结合文献分析和对欧洲社会住房实践的制度分析；案例研究涵盖维也纳、布鲁塞尔、巴塞罗那、苏黎世和希腊
AI.findings: 不同欧洲城市发展了多元化的社会导向型住房模式，包括市政和非营利住房、社区土地信托、合作住房计划及合作住房生态系统；社会经济虽不能替代福利国家或公共住房政策，但可通过促进社会创新、集体治理和社会凝聚来补充公共住房政策；希腊可通过利用公共和市政财产与社会经济实体合作，发展更具集体性和社会导向的住房形式。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了社会经济作为住房领域社会保护补充机制的理论理解，提出了社会经济与福利国家在住房保护中的互补关系框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲各国特别是希腊的住房政策制定提供比较经验借鉴，为利用公共和市政财产发展社会导向型住房提供制度路径参考。

title: Pressure as Engagement: Attention and Tone in Four Decades of the USTR's National Trade Estimate Reports
affiliations: Soongsil University

detail.title: Pressure as Engagement: Attention and Tone in Four Decades of the USTR's National Trade Estimate Reports
detail.abstract: This paper examines which trading partners the United States pressures on trade policy, and why. The National Trade Estimate Report (NTE) of the United States Trade Representative is the statutory annual inventory of foreign trade barriers: it informs the Section 301 process, is read by partner governments as a diplomatic signal, and served as the reference document for the reciprocal-tariff measures of 2025. The paper constructs a paragraph-level corpus of forty NTE editions (1986–2026; 92 partner economies; 7.55 million words) and derives two country-year measures: attention, measured by chapter length, and pressure, a dictionary-based index of demanding, concerned, condemnatory, and enforcement-oriented language. The two measures follow different patterns. Attention increases with the size of bilateral trade, whereas pressure does not. Pressure is instead concentrated on partners that are politically close to the United States and, most strongly, on partners with a US free trade agreement in force. These results indicate that international institutions have reshaped a unilateral instrument. The pre-WTO editions were dominated by the language of unilateral demand (the “aggressive unilateralism” of the 1980s), whereas under the WTO regime pressure flows through institutionalized relationships, with agreements channeling rather than resolving the expression of grievances. The reallocation often termed friend-shoring appears in attention but not in tone, and the 2026 edition, the first under the second Trump administration, shows a possible break in tone itself, with a shift from demands toward condemnation.

AI.tldr: 本文基于1986–2026年共40版美国贸易代表署《国家贸易评估报告》（NTE）的段落级语料库（覆盖92个经济体，755万词），构建了"关注度"（章节长度）与"施压强度"（基于词典的需求、关切、谴责及执法导向语言指标）两项国别-年度指标。研究发现：关注度随双边贸易规模增长而增加，但施压强度并不如此；施压集中在与美国政治关系密切、尤其是已生效自由贸易协定的伙伴国。这表明国际制度重塑了这一单边工具——WTO前版本充斥着单边需求语言（1980年代"激进单边主义"），而在WTO体制下施压通过制度化关系流动，协定起到了疏导而非解决不满的作用。所谓"友岸外包"的重分配体现在关注度而非语气上，而2026年版（特朗普第二届政府首份）在语气上出现可能断裂，从需求转向谴责。
AI.research_question: 美国在贸易政策上选择对哪些贸易伙伴施压，以及为什么选择这些伙伴？
AI.motivation: NTE报告是法定的年度外国贸易壁垒清单，是301条款程序的信息依据，被伙伴国政府视为外交信号，并作为2025年对等关税措施的参考文件。但此前缺乏对其系统性、大规模的文本分析，尤其缺乏对"关注度"与"施压"两种不同维度区分的研究。
