The findings suggest that the effects of tax-induced recycling promotion vary across taxation schemes and industrial waste categories though the taxation has thus far failed to increase the total recycled amount of industrial waste. Specifically, they indicate that taxation of intermediate treatment processes other than recycling, in addition to landfill taxation, may promote recycling. The study also indicates that for waste streams with relatively high disposal fees before waste taxation, taxation promotes the recycling of industrial waste. Additionally, it shows that the lower the baseline volume reduction/recycling rate of an industrial waste category, the greater the effect of taxation on recycling tends to be. These findings are expected to provide useful implications for the design of waste taxation schemes when introducing waste taxes in countries outside Japan.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用日本的面板数据，分析了三种工业废弃物征税方案对不同类别工业废弃物回收的影响。研究发现，税收对回收的促进作用因征税方案和废弃物类别而异，总体而言税收尚未增加工业废弃物的总回收量。具体而言，对回收以外的中间处理过程征税（加上垃圾填埋税）可能促进回收；征税前处理费用较高的废物流，税收更能促进回收；基线减容/回收率越低的废弃物类别，税收的促进作用越大。
AI.research_question: 日本三种工业废弃物征税方案对不同类别工业废弃物回收的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 废弃物处置税（填埋税和焚烧税）在发达国家被广泛用作促进3R（减量、再利用、回收）的政策工具，但已有研究对废弃物税收效果未达成共识，且缺乏按工业废弃物类别分析税收对回收促进作用的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 废弃物税收政策理论，基于污染者付费原则和3R政策框架，探讨税收对废弃物减量与回收行为的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用日本三种工业废弃物征税方案的面板数据集，按工业废弃物类别进行计量分析。
AI.findings: 1. 税收对回收的促进作用因征税方案和废弃物类别而异，但总体上未能增加工业废弃物总回收量；2. 对回收以外的中间处理过程征税（加上填埋税）可能促进回收；3. 征税前处理费用较高的废物流，税收更能促进回收；4. 基线减容/回收率越低，税收对回收的促进作用越大。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了废弃物税收对不同类别工业废弃物回收影响研究的空白，揭示了征税方案设计（特别是对中间处理过程征税）与废弃物类别特征对税收效果的重要调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为日本以外国家引入废弃物税收时的征税方案设计提供参考，包括征税对象的选择、对不同废弃物类别采取差异化政策等方面的政策启示。

title: The Class Gap in Career Progression: Evidence from US Academia
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management and University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business

detail.title: The Class Gap in Career Progression: Evidence from US Academia

declarations.funderStatement: Partially funded by a grant from the European Economic Association Career Structures Initiative

detail.abstract: Unlike gender or race, class background is rarely a focus of research on career progression, or of DEI efforts in elite occupations. Should it be? In this paper, we document a large class gap in career progression in one occupation - U.S. tenure-track academia - using parental education to proxy for class background. First-generation college graduates are 10% less likely to be tenured at an R1, are tenured at institutions ranked 11% lower, earn 3% less, and report 5% lower job satisfaction, than their former PhD classmates (from the same institution and field) with a parent with a non-PhD graduate degree. Neither selection out of academia nor different preferences explain this gap; differential research productivity also plays little role. Instead, likely drivers are differences in cultural and social capital. We also find a class gap in career progression for PhDs who work in industry, suggesting this phenomenon generalizes outside academia.

AI.tldr: 本文使用父母教育程度作为阶层背景的代理变量，记录了美国终身教职学术界中显著的阶层差距：第一代大学毕业生在R1大学获得终身教职的可能性低10%，所在机构排名低11%，收入少3%，工作满意度低5%。该差距无法用淘汰、偏好差异或研究生产力差异解释，而很可能源于文化和社会资本的差异，且在工业界的博士中也存在类似差距。
AI.research_question: 在美国终身教职学术界中，是否存在显著的阶层背景差距影响职业进展？这种差距的驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 性别和种族一直是职业进展和DEI研究的重要关注点，但阶层背景很少被研究。作者试图弥补这一研究空白，探讨阶层背景是否应在精英职业的DEI努力中得到应有重视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 阶层背景（以父母教育程度为代理）、文化资本与社会资本理论、教育代际流动性理论
AI.method: 使用父母教育程度作为阶层背景的代理变量，基于同一机构和领域的博士同学配对比较，分析终身教职学术界中的职业进展差距，并排除选择性淘汰、偏好差异、研究生产力差异等替代解释。
AI.findings: 第一代大学毕业生比父母拥有非博士研究生学位的同学，在R1获得终身教职的可能性低10%，所在机构排名低11%，收入少3%，工作满意度低5%。该差距并非由学术淘汰、偏好或研究生产力差异所致，而更可能源于文化资本和社会资本的差异。类似差距也存在于工业界的博士中。
AI.theory_contributions: 将阶层背景引入精英职业职业进展的研究视野，扩展了DEI研究的范畴；引入文化资本和社会资本理论解释职业流动性中的阶层障碍，补充了既有劳动力市场分层理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术界及其他精英职业的DEI实践提供了实证依据，表明阶层背景应成为多元化与包容性努力的重要考量维度，并为制定针对第一代大学毕业生的支持和干预政策提供了数据支撑。

title: Beyond the Legislature - The Distinction between Common Good and Public Good
affiliations: Attorney at Law

detail.title: Beyond the Legislature - The Distinction between Common Good and Public Good

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Filip Vukov, LL.M., Odvjetnik / Attorney at Law, in scholarly dialogue with Anthropic Claude Fable AI
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Filip Vukov, as a natural person

detail.abstract: Article 3(2) of the Croatian Zakon o vlasništvu i drugim stvarnim pravima withdraws a defined class of things-atmospheric air, water in rivers, lakes and the sea, and the sea shore-from the capacity to be an object of ownership, grounding the incapacity in the natural features of the thing rather than in any act of the legislature. This article argues that the provision is not a domestic peculiarity but the Croatian reception of the Roman res communes omnium, that every developed legal order in the comparison retains an equivalent, and that every one of them places the guarantee above the reach of ordinary legislation-whether by natural incapacity, by code-level inalienability, or by a public trust the sovereign "can no more abdicate … than it can abdicate its police powers". Against that framework the article examines the leading Croatian doctrinal treatment of the constitutional thresholds for public-law limitation of ownership, which distinguishes opći interes, javni interes and interes Republike Hrvatske but does not engage the classification of the objects on which expropriation operates. Because the object of expropriation in Croatian law is the immovable, and because some immovables in Croatia are general goods incapable of ownership, the term opće dobro is deployed in that literature in a context that is not object-free. Applying the author's framework of suspect ambiguity, the article shows that the same author writes the term with complete precision where the analysis concerns concessions and imprecisely where precision would constrain the taking power, and that the resulting ambiguity is asymmetric in effect. Two consequences in the same corpus are traced: the derivation of the status of the maritime domain from a sectoral statute, which inverts the hierarchy of norms; and the analogical rather than subsumptive application of Article 33 of the same statute in a case of ex lege deprivation, which routes a constitutional compensation claim into the general law of obligations and extinguishes it. Two further findings support the framework: that the division matters because the two classes resolve conflicts of interest in opposite directions, the State being proprietor of the one and steward of the other; and that Article 3(2) ZV, by enacting as positive law a doctrine Austrian law had left attached to the concept of a thing, moved the seashore from a status held by dedication to a status held by nature-a movement the derivations criticised here reverse. The article closes with a three-question diagnostic and with an equality-of-use argument drawn from Articles 3(2) and 35(4) of the property statute.

AI.tldr: 本文分析克罗地亚《所有权与其他物权法》第3条第2款——该条款将大气、河流、湖泊与海水及海岸排除在所有权客体之外，并将其依据建立在物的自然属性而非立法行为之上。文章论证该条款并非国内特殊性，而是罗马法"万民共有物"（res communes omnium）在克罗地亚的继受，且各发达法律秩序均保留了对等制度。文章进一步检视克罗地亚主流学说对征用宪法门槛的处理，揭示"公共利益"（opći interes）、"公共福利"（javni interes）与"克罗地亚共和国利益"（interes Republike Hrvatske）三重区分未涉及征用客体之分类。通过适用作者"可疑歧义"的分析框架，文章表明同一作者在涉及特许权时精确使用"公共财产"（opće dobro）一词，而在涉及征用权限制时则模糊使用，造成不对称效果。文章考察该语料中的两个后果：从部门法推导海域地位（颠倒规范层级），以及对法定剥夺案件类推适用第33条（将宪法赔偿请求转入一般债法而使其消灭）。另有两项发现支持该框架：此区分之所以重要，是因为两类客体在解决利益冲突时方向相反——国家分别是其所有者与管理人；第3条第2款将奥地利法仍附着于物之概念之上的学说定为实在法，使海岸从"因奉献而持有"之地位转为"因自然属性而持有"之地位。文章以三项诊断性问题和基于第3条第2款与第35条第4款的平等使用权论证作结。
AI.research_question: 克罗地亚《所有权与其他物权法》第3条第2款将特定类别物（大气、河流湖泊海水及海岸）排除于所有权客体之外，这一规定在何种意义上构成罗马法"万民共有物"的继受？克罗地亚主流学说在处理征用宪法门槛时，对"公共财产"（opće dobro）一词的使用是否存在不对称的歧义，以及这种歧义在规范层级与法律救济层面产生了何种后果？
AI.motivation: 克罗地亚法律中关于无主公共物（general goods）的制度安排存在理论混淆：征用学理将客体限定为不动产，但部分不动产本身即为不可所有之公共物；同时主流学说在涉及特许权时与涉及征用权限制时对"公共财产"一词的使用呈现出不一致的精确度。这种不对称歧义可能导致规范层级颠倒（由部门法推导宪法层面的海域地位）以及宪法赔偿请求被转入一般债法而消灭的实质性后果，亟需系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 罗马法"万民共有物"（res communes omnium）理论；比较法上的公共信托（public trust）理论；克罗地亚宪法中"公共利益"三重区分学说（opći interes、javni interes、interes Republike Hrvatske）；"可疑歧义"（suspect ambiguity）分析框架。
AI.method: 比较法分析（将克罗地亚第3条第2款与各发达法律秩序的对等制度进行比较）；文本与教义学分析（检视克罗地亚主流学理对征用宪法门槛的处理）；"可疑歧义"框架下的语料分析（追踪同一作者在不同语境中使用"opće dobro"一词的精确度差异）；案例与规范层级分析（考察海域地位之派生及第33条类推适用的后果）。
AI.findings: （1）克罗地亚第3条第2款并非国内特殊性，而是罗马法"万民共有物"的继受，各发达法律秩序均有对等保障机制，且均将其置于普通立法之上。（2）克罗地亚主流学理的三重利益区分未处理征用客体之分类，导致"opće dobro"一词使用语境并非无客体化。（3）同一作者在涉及特许权时对该词使用精确，在涉及征用权限制时使用模糊，构成不对称歧义。（4）该语料中存在两个后果：由部门法推导海域地位颠倒了规范层级；对ex lege剥夺案件类推适用第33条将宪法赔偿请求转入一般债法并使其消灭。（5）两类客体（国家作为所有者与管理人）在解决利益冲突时方向相反。（6）第3条第2款使海岸地位从"因奉献持有"转为"因自然属性持有"，而所述派生与类推推论逆转了这一运动。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文首次系统论证克罗地亚第3条第2款是罗马法"万民共有物"的继受而非国内特殊性，并揭示了比较法上"自然不能"、"法典层面不可让与"与"公共信托"三种保障模式的结构性对等。文章通过"可疑歧义"框架识别出学界在公共物概念使用上的不对称模糊性，并论证该歧义具有实质性的不对称效果——在规范层级层面导致部分法源颠倒宪法秩序，在法律救济层面将宪法赔偿请求消解于一般债法之中。
AI.practical_contributions: 文章提供了三项诊断性问题以检验公共物分类在具体案例中的适用，并基于第3条第2款与第35条第4款提出平等使用权论证，为克罗地亚征用法与物权法实务提供了分析工具。文章澄清了国家作为海岸所有者与管理人（steward）的双重身份差异，对法院处理涉及公共物的征用与赔偿案件具有直接指导意义。

title: Governing AI through Data Protection: Regulatory Divergence and its Political Economy across Four Major Jurisdictions

detail.title: Governing AI through Data Protection: Regulatory Divergence and its Political Economy across Four Major Jurisdictions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that she has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: No major jurisdiction wrote its data protection law with artificial intelligence in mind, yet these statutes have become the default instruments governing how AI is built and deployed. This article compares the four largest data governance jurisdictions (the European Union, China, India, and the United States) along three dimensions where their choices bite hardest: regulatory architecture, the legal basis for using personal data to train models, and individual rights over automated decisions. Read against statutory text, regulatory guidance, and enforcement practice through mid-2026, the regimes are not converging. They are pulling apart, and the reasons are economic as much as legal: path dependence, the alignment of regulatory stance with domestic industry capacity, and the sequence in which AI regulation arrived. The paper maps within-regime contradictions the comparative literature has largely missed, and identifies a blind spot common to all four: the inability to reach models trained under one regime and deployed under another, an arbitrage gap data protection law is conceptually unequipped to close. Two findings carry the argument: the Brussels Effect has exported the EU's data protection rules without exporting its regulatory architecture, and AI risk, lodged in model weights rather than in any any specific data governed by statutes, escapes all four regimes at the point of cross-border deployment. A convergent global framework is unlikely; a more manageable agenda lies in mutual recognition, sectoral floors, and pricing the externalities that divergence creates.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了欧盟、中国、印度和美国四大数据治理辖区在人工智能时代的数据保护法实践，发现各辖区监管制度不仅没有趋同，反而在监管架构、训练数据的法律基础以及自动化决策的个人权利三个维度上日益分化。文章指出了比较文献中忽略的辖区内矛盾，并揭示了四大辖区共同的盲点：无法规制在某一辖区训练、在另一辖区部署的模型，这是数据保护法在概念上无法弥合的套利缺口。
AI.research_question: 在人工智能时代，欧盟、中国、印度和美国四大数据治理辖区的数据保护法是如何规制AI的开发与部署的？各辖区之间存在怎样的分歧与矛盾？
AI.motivation: 没有任何主要法域在制定数据保护法时预见到人工智能的发展，但这些法律已成为规制AI构建和部署的默认工具。作者希望通过比较研究揭示各辖区制度的分化趋势及其深层原因，并识别共同盲点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 路径依赖理论、监管立场与国内产业能力的一致性、AI监管出台的时序效应，以及布鲁塞尔效应（Brussels Effect）理论。
AI.method: 比较法研究，基于截至2026年中期的成文法文本、监管指引和执法实践，对四大法域在三个维度（监管架构、训练数据法律基础、自动化决策个人权利）上进行系统比较分析。
AI.findings: 1. 四大法域的数据保护制度在AI层面没有趋同，而是日益分化，原因兼具经济性和法律性；2. 布鲁塞尔效应仅输出了欧盟的数据保护规则，而未输出其监管架构；3. AI风险存在于模型权重中而非任何特定数据中，导致跨境部署时四大法域均无法规制，形成套利缺口；4. 建立全球统一框架的可能性很低。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了比较文献中遗漏的辖区内矛盾；提出布鲁塞尔效应在AI时代"规则输出但架构未输出"的新观察；指出数据保护法在概念上无法解决AI跨境套利问题的理论局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出一个更可行的政策议程：包括相互承认机制、行业性最低标准（sectoral floors），以及对分歧所产生的外部性进行定价。

title:
External Validation of a Multi-Dimensional Source Credibility Framework:
Correlating Expert Ratings with Scientific Publication Output
affiliations: (Swiss Association for Non-Biased Reporting) (SVFAB)

detail.title:
External Validation of a Multi-Dimensional Source Credibility Framework:
Correlating Expert Ratings with Scientific Publication Output
detail.abstract: We present an external validation study for the Quellenampel (Source Traffic Light), a six-dimensional credibility framework for systematic source assessment in public service media (Schlaepfer, 2026b). Using bibliometric data from OpenAlex for 453 unique experts across 25 controversial topics, we test whether Dimension 3 (domain expertise) correlates with scientific publication output. A three-stage author disambiguation protocol-manual verification, automated topic matching via OpenAlex concept tags, and targeted profile search by institution-corrected 40 false name matches. ORCID-based identity verification confirmed 236 experts (52%), and topic matching against OpenAlex concept tags achieved 82% coverage (157 strong, 156 partial matches among 381 verified profiles). The resulting Spearman rank correlation is ρ = 0.591 (n = 453, p < 0.001). Subsample analysis shows that the correlation is robust across identity-confidence filters (ρ = 0.580 for high-confidence experts, n = 301) and topic-match filters (ρ = 0.557 for strong+partial matches, n = 314). The D3 bucket analysis reveals a clear monotonic gradient: experts rated D3 = +2 average 193 publications (94% with at least one), while those rated D3 = 0 average 19 (70%). The study validates D3 as a construct that captures measurable, topic-specific expertise and simultaneously demonstrates the Quellenampel's added value through five dimensions inaccessible to bibliometric indices.

AI.tldr: 本研究对Schlaepfer (2026b)提出的Quellenampel（来源红绿灯）六维可信度框架进行了外部验证，利用OpenAlex文献计量数据对25个争议话题中的453位专家进行测试，验证维度3（领域专长）与科学发表产出之间的相关性。通过三阶段作者消歧协议，发现Spearman秩相关系数ρ=0.591（n=453, p<0.001），并在子样本分析中保持稳健。研究证实D3作为可测量的、话题特定的专长构念的有效性。
AI.research_question: Quellenampel框架中的维度3（领域专长）是否与专家的科学发表产出相关，从而验证该维度作为可测量构念的有效性？
AI.motivation: Quellenampel是一个用于公共服务媒体系统化来源评估的六维可信度框架，但尚未经过外部实证验证。研究者希望通过文献计量数据检验其核心维度之一（领域专长）是否能够捕捉可测量的专家能力，从而为框架提供实证支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: Quellenampel六维可信度框架（Schlaepfer, 2026b），维度3（领域专长）作为核心验证对象，以科学发表产出作为专长的可测量代理指标。
AI.method: 使用OpenAlex文献计量数据，涵盖25个争议话题的453位专家。采用三阶段作者消歧协议：（1）手动验证（纠正40个错误姓名匹配）；（2）通过OpenAlex概念标签进行自动化话题匹配（覆盖率达82%，其中157个强匹配、156个部分匹配）；（3）基于机构校正的目标档案搜索。使用ORCID验证身份（确认236位专家，占52%），计算Spearman秩相关系数并进行子样本稳健性分析。
AI.findings: （1）Spearman秩相关系数ρ=0.591（n=453, p<0.001），表明D3评分与科学发表产出显著正相关；（2）子样本分析显示稳健性：高置信度专家ρ=0.580（n=301），强+部分话题匹配ρ=0.557（n=314）；（3）D3桶分析显示清晰单调梯度：D3=+2的专家平均发表193篇（94%至少有1篇），D3=0的专家平均仅19篇（70%）。（4）验证了D3能捕捉可测量的、话题特定的专长，同时证明Quellenampel其他五个维度提供了文献计量指标无法覆盖的增量价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对Quellenampel框架进行外部实证验证，确认D3（领域专长）作为有效构念的可测量性；同时证明了该框架的增量价值——六个维度中的五个超出了简单文献计量指标所能捕捉的能力范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共服务媒体在争议话题中进行来源评估提供了实证支持的工具框架；三阶段作者消歧协议可复用于其他类似的质量评估研究；确认科学发表产出可作为专家领域专长的有效代理指标。

title: Conditions of Future Generation in Open Knowledge Platforms: A Preliminary Discussion of a Second-Order Question in Platform Economics

detail.title: Conditions of Future Generation in Open Knowledge Platforms: A Preliminary Discussion of a Second-Order Question in Platform Economics
detail.abstract: Open knowledge platforms exhibit a set of difficulties that persist after access to their content has been made complete: attention concentrates on a small number of works, the labour of review and maintenance receives no accounting, downstream users obtain value that does not return to the arrangements which produced it, contributors are exhausted while output rises, and the relational infrastructure through which encounters occur remains held by one party. These difficulties are ordinarily described one at a time, in the vocabularies of network effects, public goods, incentive design and market power. This paper asks why they co-occur, and proposes that they share a structure the standard descriptions do not represent. The proposal is a second-order question added to ordinary platform-economic analysis and not a rival economics. Where the usual analysis of an economic mechanism examines what it produces, the question asked here is what it leaves the participants able to produce next: how a present arrangement transforms the conditions of future generation. The paper states the question, fixes its boundary by identifying what does not count as such a condition, and imposes a discipline upon its own use, namely that the question is worth asking only where it changes what an arrangement should do and not merely how the situation is described. Two results follow from taking the question seriously. The capacity to generate admits no unit, so it cannot be distributed and cannot be maximised; maximisation of it is undefined in place of undesirable, and the plurality of returns which platform designers reach for on practical grounds follows from the same fact. And since no position outside an economic description is available from which its categories could be fixed, the objects worth studying are those which survive re-description. The closed cycle is such an object, and the paper adopts it as its unit: what a single contribution was worth changes with the description, while whether a cycle returns to its own conditions does not. The paper then examines the documented difficulties one by one against a uniform template, reports which of them the question illuminates and which are already adequately explained by existing theory, and treats the capture of relational infrastructure as its principal case, since that is the cycle an operator holds in its entirety and the one which governs the amplification of every other.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个二阶问题——经济安排如何转化未来的生成条件，以解释开放知识平台中注意力集中、维护劳动无核算、价值不回流、贡献者枯竭和关系基础设施被单方持有等困难为何共同出现。论文以"封闭循环"为分析单位，指出生成能力无法度量、无法分配、无法最大化，并论证关系基础设施的捕获是支配其他所有困难的核心案例。
AI.research_question: 开放知识平台中各种持续存在的困难（注意力集中、维护劳动无核算、价值不回流、贡献者枯竭、关系基础设施被单方持有）为何会共同出现？它们是否共享某种标准经济描述无法表征的共同结构？
AI.motivation: 这些困难通常被分别用网络效应、公共物品、激励设计和市场支配力等词汇单独描述，但缺乏一个统一框架来解释它们为何共同出现。标准描述未能表征一个共享结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 二阶问题方法：在普通平台经济分析之上添加"现在安排如何转化未来生成条件"的追问；以"封闭循环"（closed cycle）为分析单位；反对可最大化性，提出生成能力不可度量、不可分配的观点。
AI.method: 概念分析/理论建构方法。论文提出一个二阶问题，界定其边界（识别什么不算生成条件），并施加自我约束（仅在改变安排应做什么而非仅改变描述时才值得提问）。随后用统一模板逐一检查各困难，区分哪些被此问题照亮、哪些已被现有理论充分解释。
AI.findings: 两个主要结果：（1）生成能力没有单位，因此不可分配也不可最大化，最大化的概念是未定义的而非不可取的；平台设计者追求多元回报的事实也源于此。（2）由于不存在经济描述之外的位置来固定其范畴，值得研究的对象是那些能在再描述中存续的对象，封闭循环即属此类——单次贡献的价值随描述变化，而循环是否回到自身条件则不随描述变化。关系基础设施的捕获是主要案例，因为它是操作者完全持有的循环，并支配其他所有困难的放大。
AI.theory_contributions: 对平台经济分析的理论贡献：（1）提出了一个统一的二阶问题框架来解释平台困难的共现结构；（2）论证了生成能力不可最大化（非"不应当"而是"未定义"）；（3）提出"封闭循环"作为跨描述稳定的分析单位，为平台经济提供新单元。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：（1）为平台设计者提供了识别哪些困难需要新解释、哪些已被现有理论充分处理的诊断工具；（2）将关系基础设施的捕获识别为最关键的治理对象，因为它支配其他困难的放大，为平台治理提供了优先方向。

title: The Political Economy of Market Regimes
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Political Economy of Market Regimes
detail.abstract: Why do financial markets enter trending regimes where momentum strategies thrive, and range-bound regimes where mean reversion dominates? This paper argues that market regimes are not random-they are the product of political motivations working through policy choices to shape market microstructure. We propose a reverse-analytical framework for regime explanation: starting from the observable dominant primitive, working backward through market microstructure and policy regime, to infer the underlying political motivations that produced the regime. The framework is demonstrated through case studies spanning Turkey, Japan, the United States, crude oil markets, Chinese equities, and the asymmetric behavior of equities versus gold. The paper is forensic in orientation-it explains past and current regimes-while the forward-looking question of regime anticipation is reserved for related work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个"反向分析"框架来解释金融市场制度（趋势/均值回归）的成因，认为市场制度并非随机，而是由政治动机通过政策选择塑造市场微观结构所产生。论文通过多个案例（土耳其、日本、美国、原油市场、中国股票市场、股票与黄金的不对称行为）进行取证式分析。
AI.research_question: 金融市场为何会进入趋势制度（动量策略有效）或区间震荡制度（均值回归策略主导）？这些市场制度的政治根源是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有文献将市场制度视为外生或随机的，作者认为市场制度是政治动机通过政策选择塑造市场微观结构的结果，需要建立解释框架来揭示制度背后的政治逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反向分析框架（reverse-analytical framework）：从可观察的主导原始因子出发，回溯市场微观结构与政策制度，推断产生该制度背后的政治动机。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，涵盖土耳其、日本、美国、原油市场、中国股票市场以及股票与黄金的不对称行为等多元案例。
AI.findings: 市场制度（趋势或均值回归）并非随机现象，而是政治动机通过政策选择作用于市场微观结构后形成的可预测结果；通过反向分析框架可以在多个国家与资产类别中成功追溯制度的政治根源。
AI.theory_contributions: 将政治因素引入市场制度形成理论，提出一种新的反向分析框架，将可观察的市场现象与不可直接观察的政治动机连接起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供理解当前市场制度成因的分析工具，有助于判断动量或均值回归策略在特定市场环境中的适用性；论文采取取证式（forensic）取向，解释过去和当前市场制度。

title: From Demand Insufficiency to Income Insufficiency: A Paradigm Reconstruction in Macroeconomics

detail.title: From Demand Insufficiency to Income Insufficiency: A Paradigm Reconstruction in Macroeconomics
detail.abstract:
For nearly a century, macroeconomics has focused primarily on demand insufficiency: why does income fail to convert adequately into spending? This paper poses a more fundamental question: why does the production system fail to generate sufficient income in the first place? We distinguish between two levels of equilibrium: production-income equilibrium (whether production generates income commensurate with its scale) and income-demand equilibrium (whether income converts into adequate demand). Mainstream theory has long focused on the latter while neglecting the former, constituting a critical blind spot that has persisted for a century.

Through analysis of the historical transformation from the postwar "Golden Age" (1950-1973) to the neoliberal era (1980-present), we find that advanced economies have undergone a systematic shift from income sufficiency to income insufficiency. Key evidence includes: wage-productivity decoupling (US productivity rose 77.5% vs. median wage 17.2% from 1973-2020), declining labor income share (from 66% to 58%), surging income inequality (US top 1% share rose from 10% to 20%), profit polarization across firms, and deteriorating job quality. This transformation reflects the systematic dismantling of institutional foundations that previously supported income formation.

The simultaneous failure of both equilibria constitutes "endogenous demand insufficiency"—an economy that can neither generate sufficient income through its production system nor convert existing income into adequate demand through its spending mechanisms. This is the deeper structural origin of "secular stagnation." The paradigm reconstruction proposed here requires analyzing how production converts into income before analyzing how income converts into demand. This completes the missing half of macroeconomics and provides a new analytical framework for understanding contemporary economic difficulties and formulating effective policy.

The next companion paper will demonstrate how this paradigm reconstruction requires fundamental rewriting of comparative advantage theory, natural rate of unemployment theory, and fiscal sustainability theory, while systematically proposing policy pathways to repair income formation mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出宏观经济学的根本性范式重建：主流经济学一个世纪以来只关注"收入-需求均衡"（收入如何转化为支出），却忽视了更根本的"生产-收入均衡"（生产系统为何未能产生足够收入）。通过分析1950-1973年"黄金时代"到1980年以来新自由主义时期的制度转型，发现发达经济体已系统性地从收入充分转向收入不足（工资-生产率脱钩、劳动收入份额下降、不平等加剧等），两个均衡的同时失效构成"内生性需求不足"，这是"长期停滞"的深层结构性根源。
AI.research_question: 为什么生产系统在源头上未能产生足够的收入？主流宏观经济学为何长期忽视"生产-收入均衡"这一更基本的问题？
AI.motivation: 宏观经济学近一个世纪主要聚焦于需求不足（收入未能充分转化为支出），但忽视了一个更根本的问题：生产系统为何从一开始就未能产生足够收入。这一"生产-收入均衡"的缺失构成宏观经济学长达百年的关键盲点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区分两个层次的均衡：（1）生产-收入均衡（生产是否产生与其规模相称的收入）；（2）收入-需求均衡（收入是否转化为充分的需求）。主流理论长期聚焦后者而忽视前者。
AI.method: 历史制度分析，对比战后"黄金时代"（1950-1973）与新自由主义时期（1980至今）的制度转型，运用关键经验证据：工资-生产率脱钩（1973-2020年美国生产率增长77.5%而中位工资仅增长17.2%）、劳动收入份额从66%降至58%、美国前1%收入份额从10%升至20%、企业间利润极化、就业质量恶化等。
AI.findings: 发达经济体经历了从收入充分到收入不足的系统性转变，这反映了支持收入形成的制度基础的系统性瓦解。两个均衡（生产-收入均衡与收入-需求均衡）的同时失效构成"内生性需求不足"，这是"长期停滞"的深层结构性根源。
AI.theory_contributions: 完成宏观经济学缺失的另一半——在分析收入如何转化为需求之前，先分析生产如何转化为收入。这一范式重建要求根本性改写比较优势理论、自然失业率理论和财政可持续性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解当代经济困难提供新的分析框架，并系统性地提出修复收入形成机制的政策路径。

detail.abstract: The study examines the legal and organizational challenges of ensuring the principle of political impartiality of the civil service in Ukraine, taking into account European standards of public administration, the experience of European Union Member States, and approaches developed in the case law of the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR). The main purpose of the article is to analyze the content of the principle of political impartiality of civil servants, determine its role in ensuring the professionalism, stability, and effectiveness of the state apparatus, and develop proposals for improving the legal regulation of this area in Ukraine. The results of the study demonstrate that political impartiality of the civil service is one of the key guarantees for the functioning of a democratic governance system, as it ensures the separation of political activities from the professional performance of administrative functions. The analysis of academic approaches and ECtHR case law indicates that the interference of political factors in the activities of civil servants may create risks to the principles of the rule of law, the independence of public administration, and equal access to civil service. At the same time, the ECtHR in its case law emphasizes the need to maintain a balance between the rights of civil servants, in particular freedom of expression and freedom of association, and the requirements of loyalty, impartiality, and proper performance of official duties. The study provides a comparative analysis of the regulatory approaches of Ukraine and selected European Union Member States regarding the protection of political neutrality of civil servants. It has been established that European civil service models are based on combining the political accountability of public authorities with the administrative independence and professionalism of civil servants. Particular attention is paid to the relationship between the principle of political impartiality and the requirements governing the conduct of civil servants as an element of their administrative and legal status. The methodology of the article includes the analysis of Ukrainian legal acts, international standards in the field of public administration, ECtHR case law, and scholarly works of Ukrainian and European researchers, as well as the application of a system of scientific research methods. The comparative legal method was used to examine the specific features of regulating political neutrality of the civil service in foreign countries. The hermeneutic method made it possible to reveal the content of the legal provisions of the Law of Ukraine "On Civil Service" in the context of implementing the principle of political impartiality. The systemic and dialectical methods enabled the identification of the interrelationship between political processes, personnel policy, and the functioning of the state apparatus. The authors substantiate the need to understand political impartiality of the civil service in a broad sense, which involves not only establishing requirements for civil servants but also defining the limits of political influence on the state apparatus and the responsibility of entities authorized to make personnel decisions. The study concludes that further improvement of Ukrainian legislation in the field of civil service is necessary by strengthening guarantees of political neutrality, ensuring transparent recruitment procedures, and developing a professional civil service in accordance with European standards of good governance and ECtHR practice.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了乌克兰公务员政治中立原则的法律与组织挑战，参照欧洲公共行政标准、欧盟成员国经验及欧洲人权法院判例法，提出完善乌克兰相关法律规范的 proposals。
AI.research_question: 如何确保乌克兰公务员的政治中立原则，并完善相关法律规制以符合欧洲标准？
AI.motivation: 公务员政治中立是民主治理体系运作的关键保障，乌克兰在此领域存在法律规制不足的问题，需要借鉴欧洲标准和经验加以改进。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治中立原则、民主治理理论、法治原则、行政独立性理论、欧洲人权法院判例法框架
AI.method: 比较法方法（乌克兰与欧盟成员国对比）、诠释学方法（解释乌克兰《公务员法》）、系统法与辩证法方法
AI.findings: 政治中立是民主治理的关键保障；欧洲公务员模式将政治问责与行政独立和专业性相结合；需在公务员言论自由/结社自由与忠诚、公正履职要求之间保持平衡；乌克兰需从广义理解政治中立，不仅规范公务员行为，还需界定政治影响限度及人事决策主体的责任。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出从广义视角理解公务员政治中立原则，将政治中立的保障范围从公务员个体行为拓展至政治干预国家机器的限度与人事决策责任的界定，丰富了公共行政领域的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌克兰完善公务员立法提供具体建议，包括加强政治中立保障、确保透明招聘程序、按欧洲善治标准和欧洲人权法院实践发展专业公务员制度。

title: An orthogonal-oracle Gaussian-process surrogate with no-fitted-parameter oxygen-content coupling for rapid-onset acceleration-induced loss of consciousness under inspired-oxygen-equivalent hypoxia

detail.title: An orthogonal-oracle Gaussian-process surrogate with no-fitted-parameter oxygen-content coupling for rapid-onset acceleration-induced loss of consciousness under inspired-oxygen-equivalent hypoxia
detail.abstract: Background and Objectives. High-altitude aviation routinely combines sustained +Gz acceleration with reduced inspired oxygen, yet no quantitative tolerance model jointly captures the two stressors. We develop and evaluate a non-classical multi-fidelity Gaussian-process framework — an orthogonal-oracle dual-surrogate composed through a closed-form physiological coupling — that predicts the corrected conditional G-LOC induction time, defined among event-positive trajectories of CGEM's E[time | event = 1] regressor channel, under combined acceleration and hypoxia in the rapid-onset regime.Methods. Two physiological simulators with disjoint feature support — the Civil Aerospace Medical Institute G-Effects Model (acceleration only) and the Pulse Physiology Engine (inspired-oxygen-fraction only) — are coupled through a no-fitted-parameter multiplicative term derived from the Hüfner arterial-oxygen-content equation. An orthogonal-oracle Gaussian-process surrogate, fit per arm on its active design axes, yields calibrated prediction intervals through split-conformal calibration. Validation anchors against a foundational 888-episode rapid-onset human centrifuge corpus from the published aerospace-medicine literature.Results. Mean absolute error against the published closed-form rapid-onset prediction is 0.58 s (n = 47 in-scope rows). 100 % of the eight rapid-onset bin-mean predictions with design coverage fall inside the published within-bin distributional envelope (|z| < 1.96; median |z| = 0.224) — a distribution-envelope plausibility diagnostic, not a mean-level agreement claim. Sobol variance decomposition attributes 25 % of corrected loss-of-consciousness-time variance — a first-order Sobol contribution of 0.2491 — to the Hüfner-coupled inspired-oxygen-fraction channel. Split-conformal calibration achieves 0.9067 marginal coverage at the nominal 0.90 target (calibration and test sets equal at 461; conformal quantile 0.0044 s).Conclusions. The framework is the first quantitative tolerance surrogate for joint acceleration and hypoxia in aviation physiology, scoped to rapid-onset profiles (Gz ≥ 4.7, onset rate ≥ 1.0 G/s), with a byte-level reproducible pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种非经典的多保真度高斯过程框架，通过封闭形式的生理耦合（Hüfner动脉血氧含量方程）将两个功能互补的生理模拟器（加速度模型和缺氧模型）结合，首次实现了对高海拔航空中加速度与缺氧联合作用下G-LOC诱导时间的定量预测，并通过888个离心机事件的公开语料验证了模型的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何在快速起效区间内，联合加速度（+Gz）与低氧（降低的吸入氧分压）两个压力源，定量预测G-LOC（重力诱导意识丧失）的修正条件诱导时间？
AI.motivation: 高海拔航空通常会同时经历持续+Gz加速度和吸入氧浓度降低，但现有文献中缺乏能够同时量化这两个压力源影响的耐受模型，存在显著的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非经典多保真度高斯过程框架；正交oracle双代理模型；Hüfner动脉血氧含量方程（用于无拟合参数的乘性耦合项）；分裂共形校准（split-conformal calibration）；Sobol方差分解。
AI.method: 将两个特征支持不重叠的生理模拟器（CAMIG效应模型处理加速度、脉冲生理引擎处理吸入氧分压）通过Hüfner方程推导的无拟合参数乘性项耦合；采用正交oracle高斯过程代理，每个臂在其活跃设计轴上独立拟合；通过分裂共形校准生成校准预测区间；以888个快速起效离心机事件的公开文献语料进行验证。
AI.findings: 对已发表的闭式快速起效预测的平均绝对误差为0.58秒（47个范围内样本）；8个快速起效分箱平均预测中100%落在已发表的箱内分布包络内（|z|<1.96，中位数|z|=0.224）；Sobol方差分解显示Hüfner耦合的吸入氧分压通道贡献了修正G-LOC时间方差的25%（一阶Sobol贡献0.2491）；分裂共形校准在名义0.90目标下实现了0.9067的边缘覆盖率。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出了航空生理学中联合加速度与低氧效应的定量耐受代理框架，填补了该领域缺乏双压力源联合建模的理论空白；将多保真度高斯过程方法从传统单一压力源场景扩展到多压力源耦合场景；通过Sobol分解量化了低氧通道对G-LOC时间的独立贡献度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高海拔航空的飞行员G-LOC风险预警提供了可量化的预测工具；具有字节级可复现流水线，便于实际工程部署与复现验证；可为航空医学中的飞行安全决策和训练标准制定提供定量依据。

title: Recovered-Ratio Inference for Loss Aversion in Subjective Well-Being and Consumption Regressions
affiliations: University of Leicester

detail.title: Recovered-Ratio Inference for Loss Aversion in Subjective Well-Being and Consumption Regressions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nothing to declare
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This paper develops recovered-ratio inference for estimating a mimicking loss-aversion index from asymmetric subjective well-being and consumption regressions. The method treats loss aversion as a maintained local restriction linking gain and loss slopes, so the recovered index is a ratio estimator rather than an ordinary regression coefficient. We derive its identification conditions, delta-method limit distribution, Wald statistic, and weak-denominator fragility, and explain when Fieller, half-Cauchy, or bootstrap inference is preferable. A Monte Carlo exercise illustrates finite-sample performance under baseline, weak-denominator, heavy-tailed, and block-mean designs. Applications to published subjective well-being and consumption studies show how the diagnostic can reinterpret asymmetric regression estimates while making clear that causal claims require valid reference points, exogeneity, and covariance information.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种"恢复比率推断"方法，用于从非对称主观幸福感和消费回归中估计模仿损失厌恶指数。该方法将损失厌恶视为连接收益和损失斜率的局部约束，恢复的指数是比率估计量而非普通回归系数。文章推导了识别条件、δ方法的极限分布、Wald统计量和弱分母脆弱性，并讨论了Fieller、半柯西或自助法推断的适用情形。蒙特卡洛实验和实证应用展示了该诊断方法的性能与解释力。
AI.research_question: 如何从非对称主观幸福感和消费回归中可靠地估计和推断损失厌恶指数（作为比率估计量）？
AI.motivation: 现有的损失厌恶研究通常将损失厌恶指数当作普通回归系数来估计和推断，忽略了其本质上是收益斜率与损失斜率的比率关系，导致统计推断可能不准确，特别是在弱分母情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 损失厌恶理论（前景理论）、比率估计量推断理论、δ方法极限分布、Fieller方法、半柯西先验推断、自助法推断
AI.method: 开发恢复比率推断方法，推导识别条件、极限分布和Wald统计量；通过蒙特卡洛实验评估不同设计（基线、弱分母、重尾、块均值）下的有限样本表现；应用于已发表的幸福感与消费研究数据进行诊断性重释。
AI.findings: 恢复的损失厌恶指数是比率估计量；在弱分母条件下，Wald推断可能失真，需要改用Fieller、半柯西或自助法；实证应用表明该诊断方法可以重新解释非对称回归估计，但因果主张需要有效的参考点、外生性和协方差信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 为损失厌恶指数的估计提供了严格的统计推断框架，明确了比率估计量与传统回归系数推断的差异，并在理论上阐明何种推断方法在何种条件下更优。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员提供了一种诊断工具，可重新解释已发表研究中的非对称回归估计，并指导如何正确选择推断方法以避免弱分母导致的错误结论。

title: Shariah-Compliant Financial Transformation and Minority Financial Inclusion in Pakistan: A Constitutional and Policy Analysis
affiliations: Sukkur IBA University

detail.title: Shariah-Compliant Financial Transformation and Minority Financial Inclusion in Pakistan: A Constitutional and Policy Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no conflicts of interest, financial or personal relationships that could have influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study because it is based exclusively on doctrinal legal analysis, publicly available policy documents, official statistics, and secondary academic literature. No human participants or personally identifiable data were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or financial support from any funding agency, commercial organization, or public institution.

detail.abstract: Pakistan is pursuing an ongoing constitutional and regulatory transition toward greater Shariah compliance in its financial system. This transition is supported by Article 38(f) of the Constitution, Federal Shariat Court jurisprudence, and State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) policy. Islamic banking has expanded substantially in assets, deposits, financing, branch networks, and digital onboarding. However, sectoral growth does not by itself establish substantive financial inclusion, particularly for religious minorities whose access, usage, consumer experience, and economic participation remain insufficiently measured. Existing Pakistani scholarship extensively examines riba elimination, Islamic banking development, constitutional questions surrounding Shariah-compliant finance, and the growth of Islamic financial institutions. Financial-inclusion research, meanwhile, primarily evaluates aggregate access, usage, and quality. Limited evidence directly examines whether Pakistan's transition toward greater Shariah compliance affects the financial access, consumer experience, and economic participation of religious minorities. This article addresses that gap by connecting Islamic financial transformation, constitutional minority rights, and measurable financial-inclusion indicators. It uses qualitative doctrinal, policy, secondary-data, thematic, and comparative analysis. The study examines the Constitution of Pakistan, Federal Shariat Court jurisprudence, SBP policy and statistics, financial-inclusion literature, minority-rights research, and comparative evidence from Malaysia and the United Kingdom. The article argues that Shariah-compliant finance is not inherently incompatible with minority economic rights. Its consequences depend on implementation conditions, including equal access, affordability, transparency, consumer protection, meaningful choice, and reliable monitoring. It proposes a Minority Financial Inclusion Indicators Framework covering access, usage, financing, affordability, quality, equality, consumer capability, digital inclusion, and economic participation. The article concludes that available official evidence demonstrates substantial institutional expansion but does not yet establish whether religious minorities have benefited from, been excluded by, or remained largely unaffected by Pakistan's Islamic financial transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文考察巴基斯坦向更高沙里亚合规金融体系转型过程中，宗教少数群体在金融可及性、消费体验和经济参与方面的实际状况。研究发现：尽管伊斯兰银行业在机构层面大幅扩张，但现有官方证据无法证明宗教少数群体是否从中获益、被排除或基本未受影响。文章提出少数群体金融包容指标体系，并论证沙里亚合规金融与少数群体经济权利并非天然冲突，其效果取决于实施条件。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦向沙里亚合规金融体系转型是否以及在多大程度上影响了宗教少数群体的金融可及性、消费体验和经济参与？
AI.motivation: 现有巴基斯坦学术研究主要关注利息消除、伊斯兰银行发展、宪法问题及伊斯兰金融机构增长，金融包容研究则侧重总体可及性、使用和质量，缺乏直接检验沙里亚合规金融转型对宗教少数群体影响的证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 伊斯兰金融转型理论、宪法少数群体权利理论、金融包容评估框架（以可及性、使用、质量、经济参与为核心维度）
AI.method: 定性多方法分析：教义分析（doctrinal）、政策分析、二手数据分析、主题分析（thematic）及比较分析（与马来西亚、英国对比）
AI.findings: ①沙里亚合规金融与少数群体经济权利并非天然不相容，其后果取决于实施条件（平等可及、可负担性、透明度、消费者保护、有意义选择、可靠监测）；②现有官方证据表明机构层面有大幅扩张，但无法确证宗教少数群体是否获益、被排除或未受影响；③提出少数群体金融包容指标体系，涵盖可及性、使用、融资、可负担性、质量、平等、消费者能力、数字包容和经济参与九个维度。
AI.theory_contributions: ①将伊斯兰金融转型、宪法少数群体权利与可测量的金融包容指标连接起来，弥合了三个领域的学术鸿沟；②论证沙里亚合规金融与少数群体经济权利之间关系的条件性，而非本质性对立；③构建了少数群体金融包容指标体系，为后续实证研究提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: ①为巴基斯坦监管机构（如巴基斯坦国家银行）提供监测宗教少数群体金融包容的指标框架；②为政策制定者提供伊斯兰金融转型中保障少数群体权利的实施条件指引；③通过马来西亚和英国比较经验为巴基斯坦政策改进提供参照。

title: Dissent, Deliberation, and Regional Influence at FOMC Meetings
affiliations: Hamilton College - Economics Department

detail.title: Dissent, Deliberation, and Regional Influence at FOMC Meetings
detail.abstract: We analyze FOMC transcripts using large language models and show that regional economic conditions affect how voting and non-voting FOMC members discuss policy preferences. The discussion of nonvoters shapes the meeting in three ways: 1) it influences how voting bank presidents vote, 2) it is associated with voters changing their expressed views in between the economic discussion phase of the meeting and the policy phase, and 3) it is associated with the position the FOMC Chair expresses during the policy round discussion. The nature of the Chair's discussion in the policy round predicts the baseline policy proposal at future meetings.

AI.tldr: 本文利用大语言模型分析FOMC会议记录，发现地区经济状况影响投票与非投票FOMC成员的政策偏好讨论，且非投票成员的讨论通过三种机制影响会议决策，同时主席在政策讨论中的发言可预测未来会议的政策提案。
AI.research_question: 地区经济状况如何影响FOMC成员（投票与非投票）的政策讨论，以及非投票成员的讨论如何影响会议决策结果？
AI.motivation: 传统研究多关注FOMC成员的投票行为，但对非投票成员在会议中的影响以及地区经济条件如何塑造政策讨论关注不足。利用大语言模型可以从大量文本中提取深层语义信息，揭示成员间互动对政策决策的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework:
基于FOMC委员会决策的集体行为理论与区域代表理论，结合大语言模型文本分析方法。" />

AI.method: 使用大语言模型（LLMs）对FOMC会议记录（transcripts）进行文本分析，识别和量化投票与非投票成员的政策偏好讨论，并考察地区经济条件与讨论内容之间的关系以及讨论对决策的影响。
AI.findings: ①非投票成员的讨论影响投票银行行长的投票行为；②非投票成员讨论与会者在经济讨论阶段与政策讨论阶段之间改变表达观点的行为相关；③非投票成员讨论与FOMC主席在政策讨论阶段表达的立场相关联；④主席在政策讨论中的发言可预测未来会议中的基线政策提案。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了FOMC内部决策过程中非投票成员的信息传递与影响机制，拓展了对货币政策委员会内部互动和决策过程的理解，证明了文本分析方法在货币经济学研究中的价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为货币政策的可预测性研究提供了新的方法路径，有助于政策制定者与市场参与者更好地理解和预测FOMC的决策方向。

title: Socioeconomic Determinants of Household Adoption of Perishable Products: An Econometric Analysis of Consumers in the City of Bukavu
affiliations: , Université Evangélique en Afrique and Université Evangélique en Afrique

detail.title: Socioeconomic Determinants of Household Adoption of Perishable Products: An Econometric Analysis of Consumers in the City of Bukavu
detail.abstract: This study analyzes consumers’ intention to adopt home refrigerated delivery services for perishable products in the city of Bukavu, as well as the design of a last-mile logistics system based on the use of refrigerated vehicles. Based on a survey conducted among 130 households, the results reveal that 54.6% of consumers are not familiar with the concept of refrigerated delivery, while 66.2% consider the service cost as the main barrier to its adoption. Statistical analyses show that education level (p = 0.004) and purchase preference (p = 0.043) significantly influence the intention to adopt, with a globally significant model (χ² = 20.811; Sig. = 0.002) and a correct classification rate of 78.5%. Moreover, monthly income (β = 0.293; p = 0.003) and education level (β = 0.176; p = 0.043) have a positive effect on sensitivity to sanitary quality.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了布卡武市消费者对易腐产品家用冷藏配送服务的采用意愿，并设计了基于冷藏车的最后一英里物流系统。基于130户家庭的调查，发现54.6%的消费者不熟悉冷藏配送概念，66.2%认为服务成本是主要障碍。教育水平和购买偏好显著影响采用意愿，模型整体显著且分类正确率达78.5%。
AI.research_question: 消费者采用家用冷藏配送服务的意愿受哪些因素影响？如何设计基于冷藏车的最后一英里物流系统？
AI.motivation: 易腐产品在城市最后一英里配送中面临保鲜挑战，而冷藏配送服务在发展中国家（如刚果民主共和国布卡武市）的采用情况尚不清楚，需要了解消费者意愿和物流系统设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者行为理论和统计分析框架，考察教育水平、购买偏好、月收入等变量对冷藏配送采用意愿及卫生质量敏感度的影响。
AI.method: 对130户家庭进行问卷调查，运用描述性统计、逻辑回归（logistic regression）等统计分析方法检验各因素对采用意愿的影响，并设计基于冷藏车的最后一英里物流系统。
AI.findings: 54.6%的消费者不熟悉冷藏配送概念；66.2%认为服务成本是主要障碍；教育水平（p=0.004）和购买偏好（p=0.043）显著影响采用意愿；模型整体显著（χ²=20.811; Sig.=0.002），分类正确率78.5%；月收入（β=0.293; p=0.003）和教育水平（β=0.176; p=0.043）对卫生质量敏感度有正向影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家城市背景下冷藏配送服务采用意愿的理论研究，识别了影响消费者采用意愿的关键人口统计学和购买行为变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为布卡武市设计冷藏车最后一英里物流系统提供实证依据，帮助企业了解消费者对成本和服务的认知，指导冷藏配送服务的市场推广和定价策略。

title: Knowing Who to Lend To - What the accounts and filings of ten digital banks in five markets show about why some of them reach profit and others do not

detail.title: Knowing Who to Lend To - What the accounts and filings of ten digital banks in five markets show about why some of them reach profit and others do not

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author participated in the Nafis Leadership Programme, Cohort III, part of the UAE Government Leaders Program, delivered by the National University of Singapore Business School Executive Education. The challenger bank counts that open this paper were first encountered in a session on that programme. Jungkiu Choi, who taught that session, subsequently provided peer review of this paper across three rounds; he is acknowledged accordingly and received no compensation. The author visited KakaoBank in Pangyo as a guest of that programme in July 2026 and met members of its management. He is a national of the United Arab Emirates, one of the markets examined. No funding was received for this research. The author holds no financial interest in any institution examined.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human participants, patients, or personal data. It is based entirely on published financial statements, regulatory disclosures and supervisory records. No ethics approval was required. A site visit to one institution took place during a leadership programme and is declared as an interest; no data from that visit is used in the paper.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding recieved for this research.

detail.abstract:
Boston Consulting Group, the management consultancy, counts 92 profitable challenger banks worldwide out of roughly 650, up from 23 of 453 two years earlier. Profitability is arriving in the sector; scale is not. This paper asks what separates the banks reaching profit from those that have not, reading the accounts, regulatory filings and supervisory records of ten digital banks across Singapore, Korea, Australia, the United Arab Emirates and Brazil for 2024 and 2025.

There is a survival threshold, illustrated by the Australian failures of 2020 to 2022, but it sits on earning assets rather than on lending: a bank holding deposits against nothing does not survive, while one holding securities and earning fees can lend almost nothing and prosper. The loan-to-deposit ratio, the measure usually applied, is a proxy for that threshold which stops working once a bank earns from anything else, and above the floor it no longer orders outcomes at all, though it continues to bear on them through funding cost.

What separates the banks already lending is the annual credit charge. Measured against the average loan book it runs from 0.51 per cent to 12.6 across the nine for which it is comparable, and in Singapore the two lowest belong to the only two banks at or near profit. That ordering holds within a market. It does not travel across pricing environments: Nubank, the largest challenger bank in the world, runs a credit charge near nine per cent and a return on equity of 33, because Brazilian yields carry it. A charge is half a sentence, and the yield is the other half.

Across two years four of the five reduced that charge and one did not. Whether those movements reflect improving judgement or losses not yet recognised on rapidly growing books cannot be settled from a ratio alone. The paper attempts a correction from disclosures banks already publish under IFRS 9, using opening balances, origination volumes and the coverage held against loans that have deteriorated but not yet defaulted, and sets out how far that gets. Five objections are put to the finding and tested against the same accounts, among them the cost-to-income ratio conventionally used in its place, and the collateral behind the lowest charges.

The pattern follows where each bank's credit judgement comes from. It can be bought, built, or borrowed from a position where transactions and repayments are already visible. Which source a bank draws on, and how far through it the bank has progressed, explains more about its trajectory than either its distribution or its deployment ratio. K bank marks the boundary: a low charge on the asset side, on a book more than half of which carries collateral or a guarantee, and a profit that fell anyway because its funding cost moved against it.

Three patterns appear only when the five markets are read together. These banks are acquiring collateral rather than moving further from it, in three markets at once. Defaults in their books leave by write-off rather than by cure. And the share of a year's charge resting on lending originated within it tracks how fast a bank is growing rather than where it operates.

Two years is the whole of the record these banks have. The paper sets out what that permits and what it does not.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析新加坡、韩国、澳大利亚、阿联酋和巴西十个数字银行2024-2025年的账目、监管申报和监管记录，探讨盈利挑战者银行与未盈利者的区别。研究发现存在一个基于生息资产的生存门槛（而非贷款），贷款存款比只是该门槛的代理指标；真正区分已放贷银行的是年度信贷成本，且这一排序仅在市场内有效，不跨定价环境。文章还利用IFRS 9披露对信用判断来源（购买、构建、借用）进行分析，并识别出三个跨市场模式。
AI.research_question: 什么因素将盈利的数字银行与未盈利的数字银行区分开来？
AI.motivation: 全球盈利挑战者银行数量从两年前的23/453增长到92/650，盈利正在到来但规模尚未形成，需要理解盈利的决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生存门槛理论（基于生息资产而非贷款）、信贷成本分析框架、IFRS 9披露框架下的信用判断来源分类（购买、构建、借用）
AI.method: 对十个数字银行2024-2025年的账目、监管申报和监管记录进行定性定量分析，包括贷款存款比、信贷成本比率、IFRS 9披露数据的交叉验证，并对五个反对意见进行检验。
AI.findings: 1. 生存门槛基于生息资产而非贷款，贷款存款比只是代理指标；2. 区分已放贷银行的是年度信贷成本（0.51%-12.6%），排序仅市场内有效；3. 信贷成本因定价环境而异（Nubank因巴西收益率高而能承受高信贷成本）；4. 信用判断来源（购买、构建、借用）比分布或部署比率更能解释银行轨迹；5. 三个跨市场模式：获取抵押品而非远离、违约通过核销而非治愈退出、年度信贷成本中当年新增贷款占比与增长速度相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了以贷款存款比作为数字银行生存与盈利衡量标准的传统观点，提出信贷成本作为更有效的区分指标，并引入信用判断来源的分类框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字银行投资者、监管者和管理者提供了识别盈利潜力的新指标（信贷成本及其来源），并警示了两年数据在推断长期趋势方面的局限性。

title:
The Templars: 
An Introductory Framework
affiliations: Universidad de la Republica

detail.title:
The Templars: 
An Introductory Framework
detail.abstract:
The Templars: An Introductory Framework is part of the Work Papers series, a collection devoted to the critical analysis of power through its discursive, legal, religious, and military manifestations. In this volume, Agustín V. Startari approaches the Templar phenomenon not as a mere medieval episode, but as a specific form of symbolic organization in which language, violence, and legitimacy converge.

Drawing on a critical study of primary sources (the Rule, papal bulls, chronicles, and trial records) and on specialist historiography, the text analyses the configuration of the militia Christi as a hybrid institutional form: religious, military, patrimonial, and legally privileged. The aim is not to attribute a secret doctrine to the Temple, but to reconstruct the documentable mechanisms through which it acquired legitimacy, autonomy, and capacity for action within Latin Christendom.

The central thesis is that Templar power depended on an architecture of legitimation composed of religious discourse, papal privilege, patronage, military organization, and material resources; its suppression reveals the reverse process, as royal action, inquisitorial procedure, and papal jurisdiction recast the Order as a suspect body. Esoteric, neo-Templar, and conspiratorial traditions are examined separately as later reception, not as evidence for the medieval Order.

 

About the Work Papers series:

This collection brings together independent studies that explore the articulation of power, ideology, and legitimacy in different historical contexts, from Ancient Egypt to twentieth-century regimes. Each volume is self-contained, but all share a common thread: the technical study of how power is constructed, exercised, and reproduced through linguistic structures, institutions, and forms of representation.

 

Agustin V. Startari (Uruguay, 1982) is a linguist and historical researcher trained at the University of the Republic. His work combines philological analysis, institutional structure, and a critique of the languages of power. He has published studies on Ancient Egypt, National Socialism, colonial evangelization, and modern propaganda, including Creation of an Empire, Propaganda Machinery, Evangelization in the Writings of Fray Bartolomé, and Ukraine and Russia: A Conflict in Progress.

His cross-disciplinary approach and methodological rigor make Work Papers a solid reference point for the study of the discursive forms of command and legitimacy.

AI.tldr: 本文从批判性权力分析视角出发，将圣殿骑士团视为一种象征性组织形态，通过原始文献（会规、教宗诏书、编年史、审判记录）与专门史研究，重建其行使权力与获取合法性的具体机制，并指出其覆灭是权力合法化架构反向运作的结果。
AI.research_question: 圣殿骑士团如何通过话语、法律、宗教与军事制度建立合法性、自主性与行动能力？其覆灭又如何揭示权力合法化架构的反向解体过程？
AI.motivation: 作者不希望将圣殿骑士团仅仅视为中世纪轶事或赋予其秘密教义，而是将其作为一种权力与合法性交会的象征性组织形式进行技术性分析，从话语批判而非神秘主义角度切入。
AI.theoretical_framework: 权力批判理论；合法性建构理论；话语分析（语言结构中的权力）；制度史与象征组织理论。
AI.method: 对原始文献（会规、教宗诏书、编年史、审判记录）进行批判性研究，结合专门史学研究，采用语言学研究（语文学分析）与制度结构分析的跨学科方法。
AI.findings: 圣殿骑士团的权力依赖于由宗教话语、教宗特权、庇护关系、军事组织和物质资源构成的合法化架构；其覆灭则体现了王室行动、宗教裁判程序与教宗管辖权将骑士团重新塑造为可疑实体的反向过程。秘传、新圣殿骑士与阴谋论传统被视作后来的接受史，而非中世纪骑士团的证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"合法化架构"（architecture of legitimation）分析框架，将权力建立与覆灭视为同一架构的正向建构与反向解体的对称过程，并将话语分析纳入历史制度研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Work Papers系列提供一份对权力的话语形式与合法性进行技术性分析的参考文本，有助于理解权力如何通过语言结构、制度与表征形式被建构、行使与再生产。

title: Refunding the IEEPA Tariffs
affiliations: and

detail.title: Refunding the IEEPA Tariffs
detail.abstract:
Refunding $166 billion in unlawful presidential tariffs imposed under purported authority of the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) presents an extraordinary challenge for tariff reliquidation and refund law. Even after the Supreme Court decided in Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump that IEEPA tariffs were unlawful, the open question remains of the legal limits of the reliquidation and refund authority of U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP). In the usual process, CBP waits for courts to decide questions about the lawfulness of a reliquidation process, generally through importer-by-importer litigation, before reliquidation. But this process appears unequal to the urgency and scale of the problem of reliquidating and refunding IEEPA tariffs. 

So far, the problem has been solved through Court of International Trade orders that have successfully encouraged CBP to use its discretionary authority to reliquidate IEEPA tariffs that are 80 days or less past liquidation. The exact nature of the solution for tariffs more than 80 days past liquidation remains to be seen. That solution likely will continue the creative approach to reliquidation taken already. At the same time it raises the question of what court decisions and explanations should take place before CBP follows a court order to reliquidate. Ultimately, the resolution should be understood in the extraordinary context of the IEEPA tariffs, even as it serves as a model for resolution of tariff controversies in the future.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在国际紧急经济权力法案（IEEPA）下非法征收的1660亿美元总统关税的退税与重新清关问题。尽管最高法院在Learning Resources v. Trump案中裁定IEEPA关税非法，但CBP的重新清关和退税权限的法律边界仍不明确。目前通过国际贸易法院的命令，CBP已成功行使自由裁量权对清关后80天内的IEEPA关税进行重新清关，但超过80天的关税解决方案仍在探索中。
AI.research_question: 美国海关与边境保护局（CBP）对非法IEEPA关税进行重新清关和退税的法律权限边界是什么？特别是超过清关后80天期限的关税应如何解决？
AI.motivation: 1660亿美元的非法IEEPA关税需要退税，但传统的逐进口商诉讼的重新清关程序无法应对这一问题的紧迫性和规模，需要探索更高效的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关税重新清关与退税法律框架，包括国际紧急经济权力法案（IEEPA）、关税清关与重新清关的法定程序和时限规定，以及行政自由裁量权在关税争议解决中的运用。
AI.method: 法律案例分析：以Learning Resources v. Trump案为核心，结合国际贸易法院（CIT）的命令实践，分析CBP重新清关权力的行使方式及其法律限度。
AI.findings: 国际贸易法院的命令已成功促使CBP行使自由裁量权，对清关后80天及以内的IEEPA关税进行重新清关；超过80天的关税解决方案仍在形成中，预计将继续采取创造性做法。
AI.theory_contributions: 为关税重新清关和退税法律提供了新的实践框架，阐明了在非常规大规模非法关税情形下行政自由裁量权与司法命令之间的互动关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为CBP处理大规模非法关税退税提供了操作路径参考，同时也为未来类似关税争议的解决提供了可借鉴的模式。

title: Grandparental Support and the Margins of Fertility Intentions: Evidence from The 2018 Spanish Fertility Survey

detail.title: Grandparental Support and the Margins of Fertility Intentions: Evidence from The 2018 Spanish Fertility Survey
detail.abstract: Fertility rates in many developed countries have fallen to historically low levels, renewing attention to the constraints that shape reproductive decision-making. In Spain, low fertility is closely tied to reduced progression beyond the first child, making fertility intentions among parents especially important. This paper builds upon Rutigliano and Lozano (2022) by revisiting the relationship between grandparental childcare support and short-term fertility intentions using nationally representative data from the 2018 Spanish Fertility Survey. It extends their study by applying a Beckerian constraint-based framework and by centering the distinction between co-residential and non-residential support in the explanation of gendered differences in fertility intentions. Using gender-stratified logistic regression models across a series of specifications, the analysis finds that grandparental support is positively associated with short-term fertility intentions among Spanish parents aged 18-45 with at least one biological child in the household. Among women, only non-residential grandparental support is associated with higher fertility intentions. Among men, the positive association is concentrated among fathers receiving co-residential support, particularly those with two or more children; because the male co-residential subgroup is small, small-sample diagnostics suggest a reasonably robust but imprecisely estimated association. These findings contribute to research on low fertility by showing that informal intergenerational support should not be treated as a uniform resource: its association with fertility intentions varies by gender, parity, and household arrangement.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于2018年西班牙生育调查数据，考察祖父母育儿支持与短期生育意愿之间的关系。研究发现祖父母支持与生育意愿呈正相关，但支持类型（同住vs非同住）与性别、子女数量存在差异化关联：女性的生育意愿与非同住的祖父母支持相关，男性则与同住支持相关（尤其是有两个及以上子女的父亲）。研究强调非正式代际支持不应被视为同质化资源。
AI.research_question: 祖父母的育儿支持如何影响西班牙父母（18-45岁）的短期生育意愿？这种关系是否因性别、支持类型（同住vs非同住）及子女数量而异？
AI.motivation: 西班牙生育率处于历史低位，且低生育与生育一胎后不再生育密切相关。此前研究（Rutigliano & Lozano 2022）虽探讨了祖父母支持与生育意愿的关系，但未充分区分支持类型及性别差异，本文旨在通过Becker约束框架加以深化。
AI.theoretical_framework: Becker约束-based框架（经济约束理论）：将生育决策视为在资源约束下理性选择的结果，即育儿成本与可得支持会影响生育意愿。本文在此基础上引入性别角色视角与家庭安排（同住vs非同住）的区分。
AI.method: 使用2018年西班牙生育调查（全国代表性数据），采用按性别分层（gender-stratified）的逻辑回归模型，跨多个规格设定进行稳健性检验，并对男性同住支持子样本进行小样本诊断。
AI.findings: （1）祖父母支持与西班牙父母短期生育意愿总体呈正相关；（2）女性中仅非同住的祖父母支持与更高生育意愿相关；（3）男性中正相关集中于接受同住支持的父亲，特别是拥有两个及以上子女者；（4）男性同住支持子样本较小，小样本诊断显示估计较为稳健但精度有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了Becker约束框架在低生育研究中的应用，证明非正式代际支持并非同质化资源，其对生育意愿的影响随性别、胎次及家庭居住安排而异，丰富了对生育决策约束来源的差异化理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供启示：在促进生育的政策设计中，需认识到不同家庭面临的支持约束差异，祖父母支持的可得性（特别是同住安排）可能带有性别和家庭结构依赖性，政策应更具针对性。

title: A Social Spin Foam Model for Power Analysis and Governance Decision-making

detail.title: A Social Spin Foam Model for Power Analysis and Governance Decision-making
detail.abstract: Governance addresses social facts that are heterogeneous in kind, relational in constitution, event-laden, and observed only in part. A state vector, a network, or a single causal model represents some of these features and not the others together. This paper develops a representation in which social facts of any type are carried by the faces of a two-complex, couplings between them are carried by edges, and joint compatibility among several coupled facts is carried by vertices, so that ontological type is independent of geometric dimension and higher-order structure, including relations among relations, is expressible without special provision. Admissibility of a coupling is shown to be the support of a non-negative edge weight, which unifies the type discipline with the weighting. Weights over histories of such structures are then defined, with configuration weights and single-fact weights obtained by marginalisation, and a criterion is given for when alternative histories compose additively, namely the presence of a record that distinguishes them. Reconstruction of structure from observation is posed as a penalised inverse problem whose output is an ensemble of weighted candidates in place of one reconstructed reality, and a minimal case with five observed facts exhibits the reconstruction of unobserved structure from divergent outcomes among closely matched cases. Power is then defined as the capacity to redistribute weight over the space of possible configurations, measured by a divergence between distributions rather than by a difference of weights, and the three received faces of power are recovered as variation at three levels of the model: labels, admissibility, and the type system itself. Governance is distinguished from power as its organised, institutionalised and accountable exercise. Decision is treated as multi-objective search over admissible configurations, returning a set of non-dominated candidates and declining to reduce them to one. The contribution is a representation adequate to heterogeneous relational facts, a definition of power as an invariant of weight redistribution, and a decision procedure that separates what computation settles from what it cannot.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于二维复形（two-complex）的表示框架，将异质性社会事实承载于二维复形的面上、事实间的耦合承载于边上、多个耦合事实的联合兼容性承载于顶点上，从而将本体论类型与几何维度分离，并统一了类型约束与加权。文章进一步定义了历史权重、给出了替代历史可加性合成的判据（记录的存在），将结构重建建模为带惩罚的逆问题，并重新定义了权力——即权重在可能配置空间上再分配的能力，用分布间的散度而非权重差来衡量。治理被界定为权力的组织化、制度化、可问责的行使。决策被视为多目标搜索，返回非支配候选集而不强行约简为单一结果。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能同时表征社会事实的异质性、关系性构成、事件荷载性与部分可观测性的统一表示框架，并在此框架下重新定义权力、治理与决策？
AI.motivation: 现有表示方法（状态向量、网络、单一因果模型）只能分别表征社会事实的部分特征，无法同时容纳所有特征，且高阶结构（如关系间的关系）和类型约束与加权之间的统一缺乏一个足够通用的形式化框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代数拓扑中的二维复形（two-complex）表示；配分函数与历史权重（路径积分式加权）；最大熵/惩罚逆问题框架；信息论中的分布散度（divergence）度量权力；多目标优化理论（非支配解集）。
AI.method: 形式化建模方法：以二维复形编码社会事实的拓扑结构；以边权非负性统一类型约束与加权；定义历史（结构演化序列）上的权重并用边际化提取配置权重与单事实权重；将结构重建转化为带惩罚的逆问题并以最小案例（五个观测事实）展示未观测结构的重建；以分布散度度量权力；以多目标搜索处理决策。
AI.findings: (1) 二维复形表示可让本体论类型独立于几何维度，高阶结构无需特殊设定即可表达；(2) 耦合的可接受性等价于非负边权支撑，统一了类型约束与加权；(3) 替代历史可加性合成的判据是存在一个能区分它们的记录；(4) 最小五事实案例表明，从相近案例的发散结果可重建未观测结构；(5) 权力可定义为权重再分配能力，以散度度量，并恢复出关于标签、可接受性和类型系统三个层面的传统权力三分面。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出一个足以容纳异质性关系事实的表示框架，将本体论类型从几何维度中解放出来；(2) 将权力重新定义为权重再分配的不变量，用分布散度度量，统一了三种经典的权力面向（标签/可接受性/类型系统三个层次）；(3) 提供了一个将计算能解决的问题与不能解决的问题分离的决策程序。
AI.practical_contributions: 为治理实践中的结构重建、权力分析与决策支持提供了一个可计算的形式化工具：可在部分观测条件下生成加权候选结构的集成（而非单一重建现实），并以多目标非支配集方式支持治理决策。

reference: Won Jun Lee, Economic Hardship as an "Impediment" under CISG Article 79: Toward a Uniform Theory for Responding to External Changes, CLOUT Network Newsletter (UNCITRAL Secretariat, Vienna), Issue #2-2026 (19 Aug. 2026), https://uncitral.un.org/en/case_law
title: Economic Hardship as an "Impediment" under CISG Article 79: Toward a Uniform Theory for Responding to External Changes

detail.title: Economic Hardship as an "Impediment" under CISG Article 79: Toward a Uniform Theory for Responding to External Changes

publicationDetails.detailsText: Won Jun Lee, Economic Hardship as an "Impediment" under CISG Article 79: Toward a Uniform Theory for Responding to External Changes, CLOUT Network Newsletter (UNCITRAL Secretariat, Vienna), Issue #2-2026 (19 Aug. 2026), https://uncitral.un.org/en/case_law

detail.abstract: Cross-border sales contracts are increasingly stress-tested by externalities that neither party caused and neither can control: tariffs, economic sanctions, export controls, supply disruptions, and volatile freight and commodity markets. When such a shock renders performance unexpectedly more onerous-though not physically impossible-the disadvantaged party's counsel faces a recurring question: does this contract, and the law governing it, offer any basis for relief, and on what theory? In other words, does this contract provide a basis for a hardship claim? The instinctive response is to reach for familiar domestic doctrines-force majeure, imprévision, Wegfall der Geschäftsgrundlage, frustration, impossibility, or impracticability. However, that instinct is precisely what Article 7(1) of the Convention cautions against. The CISG must be interpreted with regard "to its international character and to the need to promote uniformity in its application and the observance of good faith in international trade." A hardship theory built on domestic doctrines invites the homeward trend and fragments the uniform law. The appropriate approach is to develop hardship theories from within the Convention's own text and structure, especially where provisions such as Article 79 supply specifically articulated standards that may operate without resort to domestic doctrines.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了跨境销售合同在遭遇外部冲击（如关税、制裁、出口管制、供应链中断等）导致履约变得异常困难但并非不可能时，是否以及依据何种理论可以主张艰难情势（hardship）救济。作者主张不应诉诸国内法中的不可抗力、情势变更等国内法理，而应从《联合国国际货物销售合同公约》（CISG）本身的文本和结构中发展出统一的艰难情势理论，特别是利用第79条规定的标准，以避免"本国化倾向"对公约统一适用造成的破坏。
AI.research_question: 当跨境销售合同因双方均无法控制的外部冲击（如关税、制裁、出口管制、供应链中断、运费和大宗商品价格波动）导致履约变得异常困难但并非物理上不可能时，该合同及适用法律是否提供救济依据？应基于何种理论支持艰难情势（hardship）主张？
AI.motivation: 跨境销售合同日益受到双方既未造成也无法控制的外部冲击的考验，这些冲击使履约变得异常困难。实务中，律师的自然反应是诉诸国内法律中的不可抗力、情势变更、合同基础丧失、合同受挫、履行不可能或不可行等国内法理。然而，这种本能反应恰恰违背了CISG第7条第1款的要求——该公约必须考虑其国际性质、促进适用的统一性以及对国际贸易中诚信原则的遵守。基于国内法理的艰难情势理论会引发"本国化倾向"并碎片化统一法律。因此，需要从公约自身文本和结构中发展艰难情势理论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文以《联合国国际货物销售合同公约》（CISG）第7条第1款关于国际性、统一适用和诚信原则的解释原则为理论框架，重点围绕第79条（免责条款）所设定的具体标准展开分析，主张从公约内部而非借助国内法理构建艰难情势理论。
AI.method: 本文采用法律文本分析与体系解释的方法，对CISG的条款（尤其是第7条和第79条）进行深入解读，批判性地审视国内法理（如不可抗力、imprévision、交易基础丧失、合同受挫、履行不可能或不可行）在公约框架下的不当适用，并论证应从公约自身内部发展统一的艰难情势理论。
AI.findings: 本文认为，在面对艰难情势问题时，不应依赖国内法中的相关理论，而应从CISG自身的文本和结构中发展艰难情势理论。特别是第79条提供了明确表达的标准，这些标准可以在无需诉诸国内法理的情况下独立运作，从而维护公约的国际性和统一适用性。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文的理论贡献在于提出并论证了一种从CISG公约内部（而非借助国内法理）构建艰难情势理论的方法论，批判了"本国化倾向"对公约统一性造成的危害，为国际商法中的艰难情势理论提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文的实践贡献在于为跨境销售合同中的当事人及其律师提供了处理艰难情势问题的指导框架，帮助其在面临外部冲击导致履约困难时，正确识别和使用CISG第79条等公约内部条款作为救济依据，而非盲目依赖国内法理。

title: Preventing Environmental-claim Misrepresentation in the European Union: An Exploratory, Partially Agent-based Comparison of Stylised Ex-post Supervision, Voluntary Pre-Screening, and Provenance-enabled Data Exchange

detail.title: Preventing Environmental-claim Misrepresentation in the European Union: An Exploratory, Partially Agent-based Comparison of Stylised Ex-post Supervision, Voluntary Pre-Screening, and Provenance-enabled Data Exchange

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on a computer-based simulation and did not involve human participants, animals, interventions, or identifiable personal data. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Environmental-claim governance is both an information problem and a capacity problem: supervisors observe claims and incomplete evidence rather than firms’ model ground-truth environmental states, while preventive review can delay or suppress defensible communication. This paper develops an exploratory, partially agent-based simulation linking corporate environmental claims to consumers, investors, workforces, a limit-order-book market, and capacity-constrained supervision. With ten fixed corporate profiles, pre-specified agent classes, and decision rules defined ex ante, it is a transparent comparison of stipulated mechanisms rather than a search for open-ended, unanticipated emergent behaviour. It compares a stylised ex-post baseline with two hypothetical add-ons: a voluntary rule-based pre-screening hub and a provenance-enabled environmental-data connector. A 28-parameter Latin-hypercube design evaluates 200 configurations at four horizons, using three paired common-random-number replications per configuration; a post hoc outcome-diverse subset of 12 configurations is re-evaluated with 15 replications. In the archived model outputs, the hub has a positive estimated paired effect on exposure-weighted claim severity in 85.0–90.5% of sampled configurations, while increasing the modelled voluntary-communication gap and public and firm costs. The connector’s severity pattern is mixed at 120 and 365 days and positive in 97.0% and 100.0% of configurations at 1,000 and 2,000 days, while adding cost and conflict workload. These horizon patterns are descriptive and are confounded with reporting cycles, discounting, and the model’s legal calendar. Default rankings reverse across horizons in 80.5% of matched configurations and are sensitive to normative weights. The results are exploratory simulation comparisons, not empirical probabilities, causal estimates, legal conclusions, forecasts, or evidence that any institution would be effective in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个探索性的、部分基于主体的仿真模型，将企业环境信息披露与消费者、投资者、劳动力、限价订单簿市场和能力受限的监管机构联系起来。通过预先设定的规则比较了事后监管基线、自愿预审中心和数据连接器三种机制，发现预审中心对暴露加权索赔严重性有正向估计效应但增加了沟通缺口和成本，而数据连接器在长期（1000-2000天）产生了更一致的正向效果但也增加了成本和冲突负担。研究结果仅为探索性仿真比较，不构成经验概率或因果估计。
AI.research_question: 在能力受限的监管环境下，不同的环境信息披露治理机制（事后监管基线、自愿规则预审中心、供应链数据连接器）对企业的环境索赔严重性、自愿沟通缺口、公共与企业成本以及冲突工作量会产生怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 环境信息披露治理既是一个信息问题（监管者只能观察索赔和不完整证据，而非企业真实环境状态），也是一个能力问题（预防性审查可能延迟或压制合理的沟通）。现有研究缺乏对这两种约束下不同治理机制效果的比较分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于主体建模（ABM）框架，融合了多利益相关者互动理论，包括消费者、投资者、劳动力市场反应机制，以及限价订单簿市场微观结构和能力约束监管理论。
AI.method: 采用探索性的部分基于主体仿真，设定10个固定企业画像、预先指定的代理类别和决策规则。使用28参数拉丁超立方体设计评估200个配置（4个时间范围），每配置3次配对公共随机数重复；对12个结果多样性子集进行15次重复再评估。
AI.findings: 预审中心在85.0-90.5%的配置中对暴露加权索赔严重性有正向估计配对效应，但增加了自愿沟通缺口和公共及企业成本；数据连接器的严重性模式在120和365天表现混合，在1000和2000天分别有97.0%和100.0%的配置为正向，同时也增加了成本和冲突工作量。默认排名在80.5%的匹配配置中随时间范围逆转，并对规范权重敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文为环境信息披露治理研究提供了一个透明的机制比较仿真框架，揭示了治理机制的效果随评估时间范围而变化的关键理论洞见，表明仅基于短期结果评估治理机制可能得出误导性结论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和监管者提供了关于自愿预审中心和供应链数据连接器两种治理工具的探索性比较证据，帮助理解不同机制在短期与长期的效果差异及其成本代价，尽管结论需谨慎解读。

title: Border and Retail Market Impacts of Tariffs in US Wine Markets
affiliations: Virginia Tech

detail.title: Border and Retail Market Impacts of Tariffs in US Wine Markets
detail.abstract: We examine how tariffs are transmitted along the supply chain in a differentiated product market, focusing on the 25% U.S. tariffs imposed on wine imports from four European countries between November 2019 and February 2021. Using import records and retail scanner data, we find that two parties bear the tariff primarily: foreign exporters absorbed 44.6% ($0.70/Liter) of the tariff through lower FOB prices, and U.S. consumers bore 57.9% ($0.91/Liter) through higher retail prices. The implied residual on domestic intermediariesimporters, wholesalers, and retailers-is a small markup expansion of $0.04 per liter (or 2.5% of the tariff payment). The tariffs also generate significant competitive spillovers onto U.S. domestic wines, raising their retail prices by 4.3% and increasing their retail revenue by 2.6%. These retail market dynamics and competitive spillovers are critical to understanding price impacts of tariffs in differentiated product markets.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2019年11月至2021年2月美国对四个欧洲国家葡萄酒征收25%关税的自然实验，结合进口记录和零售扫描数据，研究了关税在差异化产品市场的供应链传导机制。研究发现：外国出口商通过降低FOB价格吸收了44.6%的关税，美国消费者通过零售价格上涨承担了57.9%的关税，而国内中间商仅承担了2.5%的关税。此外，关税还对美国国产葡萄酒产生了显著的竞争溢出效应，使其零售价格上涨4.3%、零售收入增加2.6%。
AI.research_question: 关税在差异化产品市场中如何沿供应链传导？各环节（外国出口商、国内进口商/批发商/零售商、消费者）分别承担多少关税负担？关税对国内竞争产品产生何种溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 既有研究大多聚焦于同质化产品的关税传导，对差异化产品市场中关税沿供应链各环节的分配机制缺乏系统理解。特别是中间商的定价行为和进出口两侧的关税负担分配未被充分揭示，而竞争溢出效应更是此前研究较少关注的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关税负担理论（tariff incidence）与供应链传导理论；差异化产品市场竞争理论。
AI.method: 利用2019-2021年美国对四个欧洲国家葡萄酒征收25%关税这一准自然实验，结合海关进出口记录（FOB价格数据）和零售扫描数据，通过事件研究/差异中差异方法估计关税在供应链各环节的传导效应。
AI.findings: (1) 外国出口商通过降低FOB价格承担44.6%（$0.70/升）的关税；(2) 美国消费者通过零售价格上升承担57.9%（$0.91/升）的关税；(3) 国内中间商（进口商、批发商、零售商）仅扩大边际加成$0.04/升（占关税支付的2.5%）；(4) 关税对美国国产葡萄酒产生竞争溢出效应，使其零售价格上升4.3%，零售收入增加2.6%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在差异化产品市场中系统量化关税沿供应链各环节的分配，揭示了传统观点（认为中间商从中获利）与实际不符——中间商仅获得极小边际加成扩大。同时拓展了关税竞争溢出效应理论，表明关税不仅影响进口品本身，还会通过竞争渠道传导至国内替代品市场。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估关税政策的实际福利效应提供量化证据，说明在差异化产品市场中，关税的最终负担主要落在外国出口商和美国消费者身上，而非中间商；同时也提示国内生产商可能从针对进口品的关税中获得竞争性收益，这对关税政策的政治经济学评估具有重要参考价值。

title: "Sustainable Development, Digital Trade Agreements and the Digital Economy"

detail.title: "Sustainable Development, Digital Trade Agreements and the Digital Economy"
detail.abstract:
In the last few years, states and regional organizations have signed digital trade agreements
including digital partnership agreements. Unlike traditional trade agreements, digital trade
agreements aim to harness digitally ordered and/or digitally delivered transactions. Recently
signed digital trade agreements include the 2024 Digital Trade Protocol of the African
Continental Free Trade Area Agreement and the 2025 Agreement on digital trade between the
European Union and the Republic of Korea. Exponential growth in cross-border digital trade
is creating new legal and economic development challenges which are not adequately
addressed under the law of international economic development. While several of these
challenges have been identified in existing literature, there is very little focus on the
relationship between protection of the environment and the digital economy. The main research
question this paper addresses is: How do states incorporate sustainability concerns into digital
trade agreements? Other questions addressed are: Are digital trade agreements adequate for
dealing with environmental concerns? What role do Panels established under the World Trade
Organization’s Dispute Settlement Understanding and investment arbitration tribunals play in
norm setting? How can states and stakeholders ensure a balance between protecting the
environment and fostering cross border digital trade? To address these question, this paper is
based on a textual analysis of sustainability provisions in recently signed digital trade
agreements. In addition, this paper analyses policy statements of states and digital economy
strategies to show how national policies can influence the negotiating texts of international
agreements. This shows divergences and convergences between economic development as a
domestic norm and as a transnational norm. Overall, this paper argues that the securitization
of trade law, economic security and geoeconomics are hindering the inclusion of sustainability
provisions in digital trade agreements. It will make proposals for future negotiations of digital
trade agreements.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨各国如何将可持续性关切纳入数字贸易协定，通过文本分析近期签署的数字贸易协定中的可持续性条款及国家政策声明，论证贸易法的安全化、经济安全和地缘经济学正在阻碍可持续性条款被纳入数字贸易协定，并提出未来谈判建议。
AI.research_question: 主要研究问题：各国如何将可持续性关切纳入数字贸易协定？次要问题包括：数字贸易协定是否足以应对环境关切？WTO争端解决机制下的专家组和投资仲裁庭在规范制定中扮演什么角色？国家和利益相关者如何确保环境保护与跨境数字贸易之间的平衡？
AI.motivation: 跨境数字贸易指数级增长正在创造新的法律和经济发展挑战，而国际经济发展法未能充分应对。现有文献虽识别了若干挑战，但很少关注环境保护与数字经济之间的关系，因此需要填补这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文借鉴国际贸易法、国际经济发展法、可持续性规范、安全化理论（securitization）以及经济安全和地缘经济学等理论框架，考察国内规范与跨国规范之间的趋同与分歧。
AI.method: 采用文本分析法，对近期签署的数字贸易协定中的可持续性条款进行文本分析；同时分析各国政策声明和数字经济战略，以展示国家政策如何影响国际协定的谈判文本。
AI.findings: 研究发现贸易法的安全化、经济安全和地缘经济学正在阻碍可持续性条款被纳入数字贸易协定；同时揭示了经济发展作为国内规范与跨国规范之间的分歧与趋同。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文将可持续性议题引入数字贸易协定研究领域，填补了环境保护与数字经济之间关系的研究空白；并通过对国内规范与跨国规范的比较分析，丰富了国际经济发展法理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为未来数字贸易协定的谈判提供具体建议，帮助国家和利益相关者在保护环境与促进跨境数字贸易之间取得平衡。

title: Service Triage with Multimodal Evidence
affiliations: City University of Hong Kong and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - School of Engineering

detail.title: Service Triage with Multimodal Evidence
detail.abstract: Problem Definition. Service operations such as returns, warranty claims, disputes, and remote inspections increasingly arrive as narratives and images. For such cases, multimodal models can estimate the probability that each case is valid, identify covered and missing checklist elements, and formulate targeted evidence requests. We study how firms should use these outputs to accept or deny cases, request targeted images, or assign scarce expert review. Methodology/Results. We formulate a two-layer model in which a rich evidence state preserves the checklist and the identities of covered and missing elements, while validity probability and weighted coverage support routing when the coverage reduction is valid. We characterize when one coverage dimension represents both request opportunity and usefulness for review, and derive the value of retaining the rich state. This value is positive precisely when record differences within an equal-belief, equal-coverage cell cross an action boundary, and costly continuation occurs around the accept-deny threshold. When request value decreases and review value increases with coverage, three channel regimes emerge, including a unique request-review frontier under intermediate conditions. With limited review capacity, cases are ranked by review surplus relative to the best nonreview action. Numerical experiments and a public-data validation study illustrate the results and assess multimodal evidence-state extraction. Managerial Implications. Firms should preserve both validity probabilities and the rich evidence state of each case. They should validate coverage near action boundaries, direct incomplete cases to targeted evidence requests, and reserve experts for assembled but unresolved records whose ambiguity can change resolution. Review capacity should be allocated by review surplus after accounting for the targeted-request option, and deployment validation should evaluate both belief calibration and covered-set and missing-set recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文研究企业在面对以文本和图像形式到达的服务运营案例（如退货、保修索赔、纠纷、远程检查）时，如何利用多模态模型的输出（有效性概率、清单覆盖情况、缺失要素）来决定接受/拒绝案例、请求针对性图像，或分配稀缺的专家审查资源。作者构建了一个两层模型，刻画了丰富证据状态的价值，并推导出在覆盖度表示请求机会和审查价值时的通道机制及审查能力有限时的排序规则。
AI.research_question: 企业应如何利用多模态模型输出的有效性概率和证据覆盖信息，来制定案例接受/拒绝、针对性图像请求和稀缺专家审查的决策策略？
AI.motivation: 服务运营案例（退货、保修、纠纷、远程检查）日益以叙述和图像形式呈现，多模态模型可以估计案例有效性概率并识别清单要素的覆盖和缺失情况，但企业缺乏将这些输出转化为运营决策（接受/拒绝、请求证据、分配专家）的系统性指导框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两层决策模型：上层为案例处置决策（接受/拒绝/请求图像/专家审查），下层为证据状态模型——丰富证据状态保留清单及覆盖/缺失要素的标识，有效性概率和加权覆盖率用于路由决策。
AI.method: 理论建模（两层优化模型）与数值实验、公开数据验证研究相结合。
AI.findings: （1）丰富状态的价值在等信念、等覆盖单元内的记录差异跨越行动边界时为正；（2）当请求价值随覆盖率递减而审查价值随覆盖率递增时，出现三种通道机制，在中间条件下存在唯一的请求-审查前沿；（3）审查能力有限时，案例应按相对于最佳非审查行动的审查盈余排序。
AI.theory_contributions: 刻画了单一覆盖维度何时同时代表请求机会和审查效用的条件；推导出保留丰富证据状态（而非仅保留汇总信念）的价值条件；识别了请求-审查前沿的存在性及通道机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议企业同时保留有效性概率和丰富证据状态；在行动边界附近验证覆盖率；引导不完整案例进行针对性证据请求；将专家资源保留给已组装但未解决的、歧义可能改变结论的记录；审查容量按计入针对性请求选项后的审查盈余分配；部署验证应同时评估信念校准及覆盖集/缺失集恢复。

title: Data Center Water Extraction and the Right to Water: Environmental Cost Recovery and Policy Design in India's Water-Stressed Zones
affiliations: and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Data Center Water Extraction and the Right to Water: Environmental Cost Recovery and Policy Design in India's Water-Stressed Zones

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Authors declare no financial conflict of interest. [The research paper is purely for academic purpose and the views expressed our personal bearing no relation to any individual or organisation that the co-authors may be associated with in the past, at present or in the future. The research was divided based on the areas of expertise of each co-author, that is technology specific portion contributed by Co Author Karthik and legal policy contribution along with recommendations by Co Author Purva.]
declarations.ethicsApproval: All data sources are publicly available through Ministry of Jal Shakti, news archives, court records, or Government of India websites. Environmental clearance documents referenced are available through RTI requests to respective state Environmental Assessment Authorities.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding has been received for this publication/ academic work.

detail.abstract: India confronts a policy collision between digital infrastructure expansion and water security that demands urgent resolution. Data centers essential to AI capability are being allocated water from aquifers already in critical depletion, with allocation patterns systematically prioritizing infrastructure over drinking water. In Visakhapatnam (Andhra Pradesh), data center water allocations estimated between 30-80 million liters per day coexist with community water rationing to far below sustainable levels. The city receives 410 million liters daily against a requirement of 480 million liters, creating structural shortage even before accounting for new industrial demand. In Chennai, seven million people face their worst water shortage in eighty years while data center expansion proceeds. This paper analyzes the legal and policy basis for this allocation hierarchy and demonstrates that the de facto prioritization of data center water lacks formal legislative foundation and violates constitutional rights. Article 21 of the Constitution guarantees the right to life, which jurisprudence has established includes access to water. This prioritization also contradicts the Water Act 1974, Section 3, which mandates equitable allocation across competing users. We propose an Environmental Cost Recovery Framework that achieves three objectives. First, it internalizes full environmental costs through graduated water pricing indexed to groundwater stress zones. A data center in a Dark Red zone (critical depletion) would pay ₹1,000 per thousand liters above a baseline allocation, creating financial incentive for technology adoption without absolute restriction.
